558.t: bharam dharam kai gio paap prachario jahaa teh ||73||
558.e: One sect will die out everyday and the other one will become prevalent, there will be no religious karmas and the situation of the earth will also changes, the dharma will not be honoured and there will be the propagation of sin everywhere.73.

558.g: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਇਸਟ ਤਜਿ ਦੀਨ ਕਰਤ ਆਰਿਸਟ ਪੁਸਟ ਸਬ ॥
558.t: sirasaT isaT taj dheen karat aarisaT pusaT sab ||

558.g: ਬ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੀ ਭਏ ਪਾਪਿਸਟ ਭ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਤਬ ॥
558.t: birasaT sirasaT te miTee bhe paapisaT bhirasaT tab ||

558.g: ਇਕ ਇਕ ਨਿੰਦ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਇਕ ਕਹਿ ਹਸਿ ਚਲੈ ॥੭੪॥
558.t: eik ik ni(n)dh hai ik ik keh has chalai ||74||
558.e: The people of the earth, leaving their religion, will  74be engrossed in very great sinful acts and when all will become defiled on account of sinful acts, even the rain will not fall on the earth, everyone will slander the other and move away after derid

558.g: ਤਜੀ ਆਨਿ ਜਹਾਨ ਕਾਨਿ ਕਾਹੂੰ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥
558.t: tajee aan jahaan kaan kaahoo(n) nahee maaneh ||

558.g: ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦ ਨੀਚ ਊਚਹ ਸਮ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
558.t: taat maat kee ni(n)dh neech uoocheh sam jaaneh ||

558.g: ਧਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਕੈ ਗਇਓ ਭਈ ਇਕ ਬਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਸਬ ॥੭੫॥
558.t: dharam bharam kai gio bhiee ik baran prajaa sab ||75||
558.e: Forsaking the respect and honour of others, none will accept the advice of any other, none will accept the advice of any other, there will be the calumniation of the parents and the low people will be considered as high ones 75

558.g: ਘਤਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
558.t: ghataa chha(n)dh ||
558.e: GHATTA STANZA

558.g: ਕਰਿ ਹੈ ਪਾਪ ਅਨੇਕ ਨ ਏਕ ਧਰਮ ਕਰ ਹੈ ਨਰ ॥
558.t: kar hai paap anek na ek dharam kar hai nar ||

558.g: ਮਿਟ ਜੈ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਖਸਟ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਧਰਮ ਘਰਨ ਘਰਿ ॥
558.t: miT jai hai sabh khasaT karam ke dharam gharan ghar ||
558.e: The people will commit many sins and will not even do one task of righteousness

558.g: ਨਹਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਮੈ ਹੈ ਅਧੋਗਤਿ ਜੈ ਹੈ ॥
558.t: neh sukirat kamai hai adhogat jai hai ||

558.g: ਅਮਰ ਲੋਗਿ ਜੈ ਹੈ ਨ ਬਰ ॥੭੬॥
558.t: amar log jai hai na bar ||76||
558.e: The six karmas will be finished from all the home and no one, on account of not doing good deeds, will enter the region of immortality and all will obtain the position of deg

558.g: ਧਰਮ ਨ ਕਰ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਪਾਪ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਸਬ ॥
558.t: dharam na kar hai ek anek paap kai hai sab ||

558.g: ਲਾਜ ਬੇਚਿ ਤਹ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਕਲ ਜਗੁ ॥
558.t: laaj bech teh firai sakal jag ||
558.e: Not even performing one act of righteousness, all will commit sinful acts

559.g: ਪਾਪ ਕਮੈ ਵਹ ਦੁਰਗਤਿ ਪੈ ਹੈ ॥
559.t: paap kamai veh dhuragat pai hai ||

559.g: ਪਾਪ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਜੈ ਹੈ ਨ ਤਰਿ ॥੭੭॥
559.t: paap samu(n)dh jai hai na tar ||77||
559.e: They will move in the world unashamedly, they will earn through sinful acts and suffer catastrophies and will remain powerless and will not be able to ferry across the sea of sin.7
DOHRA

559.g: ਠਉਰ ਠਉਰ ਨਵ ਮਤ ਚਲੇ ਉਠਾ ਧਰਮ ਕੋ ਦੌਰ ॥
559.t: Thaur Thaur nav mat chale uThaa dharam ko dhauar ||
559.e: New sects will arise at various places and the impact of dharma will end

559.g: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਹ ਤਹ ਦੁਰ ਰਹੀ ਪਾਪ ਭਇਓ ਸਿਰਮੌਰ ॥੭੮॥
559.t: sukirat jeh teh dhur rahee paap bhio siramauar ||78||
559.e: The goodness will remain concealed and the sin will dance everywhere.78.
NAVPADI STANZA

559.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਕਰਨ ਲਗੇ ਸਭ ਪਾਪਨ ॥
559.t: jeh teh karan lage sabh paapan ||

559.g: ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਤਜਿ ਕਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਨ ॥
559.t: dharam karam taj kar har jaapan ||
559.e: Here and there all will leave the religious injunctions and the remembrance of the Name of the Lord and perform the sinful acts

559.g: ਪਾਹਨ ਕਉ ਸੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਬ ਬੰਦਨ ॥
559.t: paahan kau su karat sab ba(n)dhan ||

559.e: The stone-idols will be worshipped and only on them incense. Lamp-lights and sandal will be offered.79.

559.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਤਜਿ ਭਾਗਤ ॥
559.t: jeh teh dharam karam taj bhaagat ||

559.g: ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਸੌ ਲਾਗਤ ॥
559.t: auTh uTh paap karam sau laagat ||
559.e: Here and there, forsaking the religious injunction, people will run away, they will be absorbed in sinful acts

559.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਭਈ ਧਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਲੋਪੰ ॥
559.t: jeh teh bhiee dharam gat lopa(n) ||

559.e: No religion will remain visible and the sin will become fourfold.80.
Forsaking their religious injunctions the people will run away in such a way as if they had seen a bad dread
All the people will abandon their wives and will repeat evil notions.81.

559.g: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਘੋਰ ਪ੍ਰਚਰ ਭਇਓ ਪਾਪਾ ॥
559.t: chahu dhis ghor prachar bhio paapaa ||

559.g: ਕੋਊ ਨ ਜਾਪ ਸਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਾ ॥
559.t: kouoo na jaap sakai har jaapaa ||
559.e: Because of the prevalence of sin in all the four directions, no one will be able to remember the Lord

559.g: ਪਾਪ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਚਲ ਪਈ ॥
559.t: paap kriaa sabh jaa chal piee ||

559.g: ਧਰਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਯਾ ਜਗ ਤੇ ਗਈ ॥੮੨॥
559.t: dharam kriaa yaa jag te giee ||82||
559.e: The sinful tendencies will prevail in such a way that all the religious acts will be finished in the world.82.
ARIL SECOND
Because of the birth of adharma here and there, the dharma will get wings and fly away

559.g: ਲਾਗਤ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਧਰਮ ਕੋ ਦਾਵਨ ॥੮੩॥
559.t: laagat kat hee dharam ko dhaavan ||83||
559.e: The bad people will roam here and there and the turn of dharma will never come.83.

559.g: ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਚਿਤਿ ਏਕ ਨ ਲਿਆਵਤ ॥
559.t: dharam karam chit ek na liaavat ||
559.e: The people will make meaningless all the meaningful things and will never let the notion of religious karmas enter there mind
Forgetting the activities of dharma, they will propagate about sin here and there.84.
KULAK STANZA
They will not perform the acts of dharma, they will not utter the Name of the Lord
They will enter the houses of others and churning water, they will try to realise the essence.85.
Without understanding the real meaning, they will deliver useless speeches and adopting the temporary religions, they will never talk about the truth.86.
Entering the houses of other, they will roam and speak here and there and will remain absorbed with others women.87.
Covering for wealth, they will go for theft during the night
They will be destroyed collectively and will go to hell.88.

560.e: Because of their such-like sinful acts, no dharma will be left in the world
The parents will not enter the houses being frightened.89.
The disciples will turn away from their Guru and the servants will leave the king
The wife, relinquishing her husband, will also forget the Lord.90.
Because of the new types of Karmas, the illusions will increase
The whole world will become sinful and no person repeating the Name or performing austerities, will be left in the world.91.
PADMAVATI STANZA

560.g: ਦੇਖੀਅਤ ਸਬ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀ ਤਦਿਪ ਮਹਾ ਰਿਸ ਠਾਨੈ ॥
560.t: dhekheeat sab paapee neh har jaapee tadhip mahaa ris Thaanai ||
560.e: The sinners will be seen on all sides, there will be no meditation on the Lord

560.g: ਅਤਿ ਬਿਭਚਾਰੀ ਪਰਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਰੀ ਦੇਵ ਪਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
560.t: at bibhachaaree paratria bhaaree dhev pitr nahee maanai ||
560.e: Even then there will be great jealousy with one another those who go to the wives of others and commit sinful acts will have no beliefs in gods and manes

560.g: ਤਦਿਪ ਮਹਾ ਬਰ ਕਹਤੇ ਧਰਮ ਧਰ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
560.t: tadhip mahaa bar kahate dharam dhar paap karam adhikaaree ||
560.e: Even then the sinners will remain religious leader

560.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਸਭ ਆਖੈ ਮੁਖ ਪਰ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਖੈ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਚੜਿ ਗਾਰੀ ॥੯੨॥
560.t: dhirag dhirag sabh aakhai mukh par nahee bhaakhai dheh pirasaT chaR gaaree ||92||
560.e: None will talk on the face, but slander others at the back.92.

560.g: ਦੇਖੀਅਤ ਬਿਨ ਕਰਮੰ ਤਜ ਕੁਲ ਧਰਮੰ ਤਦਿਪ ਕਹਾਤ ਸੁ ਮਾਨਸ ॥
560.t: dhekheeat bin karama(n) taj kul dharama(n) tadhip kahaat su maanas ||
560.e: Without doing good work and forsaking the traditional religion of the clan, the people even then will be called good persons

560.g: ਅਤਿ ਰਤਿ ਲੋਭੰ ਰਹਤ ਸਛੋਭੰ ਲੋਕ ਸਗਲ ਭਲੁ ਜਾਨਸ ॥
560.t: at rat lobha(n) rahat sachhobha(n) lok sagal bhal jaanas ||
560.e: The people will consider those persons good, who will always remain anxious, coveting in their mind for the sexual enjoyment

560.g: ਤਦਿਪ ਬਿਨਾ ਗਤਿ ਚਲਤ ਬੁਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਸਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
560.t: tadhip binaa gat chalat buree mat lobh moh bas bhaaree ||
560.e: The people will follow the vicious doctrines under the impact of great greed and attachment

560.g: ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਲੈਹ ਘਰਣ ਤੇ ਗਾਰੀ ॥੯੩॥
560.t: pit maat na maanai kachhoo na jaanai laih gharan te gaaree ||93||
560.e: They will have no love for their parents and will be rebuked by their wives.93.

560.g: ਦੇਖਅਤ ਜੇ ਧਰਮੀ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਅਕਰਮੀ ਤਦਿਪ ਕਹਾਤ ਮਹਾ ਮਤਿ ॥
560.t: dhekhat je dharamee te bhe akaramee tadhip kahaat mahaa mat ||
560.e: The pious ones will be seen performing bad acts and even then they would like to be called good ones

560.g: ਅਤਿ ਬਸ ਨਾਰੀ ਅਬਗਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਤ ॥
560.t: at bas naaree abagat bhaaree jaanat sakal binaa jat ||
560.e: All of them will be under the impact of their women and remaining without restraint, they will be in decadence

560.g: ਤਦਿਪ ਨ ਮਾਨਤ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਠਾਨਤ ਮਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
560.t: tadhip na maanat kumat praThaanat mat ar gat ke kaache ||
560.e: Even then, the people without intellect, will not shirk from the performance of bad karmas

560.g: ਜਿਹ ਤਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਡੋਲਤ ਭਲੇ ਨ ਬੋਲਤ ਲੋਗ ਲਾਜ ਤਜਿ ਨਾਚੇ ॥੯੪॥
560.t: jeh teh ghar ddolat bhale na bolat log laaj taj naache ||94||
560.e: They will roam here and there uttering uncivilized words and will also dance unashamedly.94.
KILKA STANZA

560.g: ਜਨੁ ਦੋਖਨ ਕੇ ਤਰੁ ਸੁਧ ਬਨੇ ॥
560.t: jan dhokhan ke tar sudh bane ||
560.e: They will commit new sins and talking about the blemishes of others, they themselves will remain pure

560.g: ਜਗ ਛੋਰਿ ਭਜਾ ਗਤਿ ਧਰਮਣ ਕੀ ॥
560.t: jag chhor bhajaa gat dharaman kee ||

560.g: ਸੁ ਜਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਪਾਪ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਚੁਰੀ ॥੯੫॥
560.t: s jahaa tahaa paap kriaa prachuree ||95||
560.e: The followers of the religions, will forsake the world and run away and there will be the propagation of the sinful activities here and there.95.

560.g: ਤਜਿ ਭਾਜ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਜਗ ਜਾਪਨ ਕੀ ॥
560.t: taj bhaaj kriaa jag jaapan kee ||
560.e: All of them will roam, committing sinful acts and the activites of recitation and worship will flee from the world
They will not have any faith in gods and manes and will consider all others inferior to them.96.
MADHUBHAAR STANZA
The dharma will run away and there will be propagation of evil Karmas
There will not remain any propriety of conduct in the world.97.
The powerful people will always commit bad deeds and the dharma will flee alongwith goods acts.98.
Forsaking good character, all will be absorbed in bad conduct and wonderful activities will become apparent at several places.99.

561.e: Not absorbing themselves with the sexual enjoyment with their wives, they will have sexual relations with these unbecoming daughter.100.
The whole society will be on the run for the abandonment of shame
Adharma will increase and dharma will decrease.101.
Forsaking dharma, the people will have sexual enjoyment with the prostitutes
The illusions will increase and the dharma will run away.102.
In all the countries, amongst the sinful kings, no follower of dharma will be left.103.
The saints, in their fear, will be seen in depression here and there
The sin will reign in all the houses.104.

561.g: ਸਬ ਦ੍ਰੋਨ ਗਿਰਵਰ ਸਿਖਰ ਤਰ ਨਰ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਭਏ ਭਨੌ ॥
561.t: sab dhron giravar sikhar tar nar paap karam bhe bhanau ||
561.e: Somewhere there will be very great sins like the top of Dronagiri mountain

561.g: ਉਠਿ ਭਾਜ ਧਰਮ ਸਭਰਮ ਹੁਐ ਚਮਕੰਤ ਦਾਮਿਨਿ ਸੋ ਮਨੌ ॥
561.t: auTh bhaaj dharam sabharam huaai chamaka(n)t dhaamin so manau ||
561.e: All the people will abandon dharma and live in the flashing lighting of illusion

561.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਸੁਭਟ ਸਮਾਜ ਸੰਜੁਤ ਜੀਤ ਹੈ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਥਲੀ ॥
561.t: kidhau soodhr subhaT samaaj sa(n)jut jeet hai basudhaa thalee ||
561.e: Somewhere the Shudras, bedecked with warriors will conquer the earth and somewhere the Kshatriyas, forsaking the weapons and arms, will be running hither and thither

561.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਅਤ੍ਰ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਤਜੇ ਭਜੇ ਅਰੁ ਅਉਰ ਅਉਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਚਲੀ ॥੧੦੫॥
561.t: kidhau atr chhatr taje bhaje ar aaur aaur kriaa chalee ||105||
561.e: There will be the prevalence of different types of activities.105.

562.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਜਹ ਤਹ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਸਬੈ ਲਗੇ ॥
562.t: nirap dhes dhes bidhes jeh teh paap karam sabai lage ||
562.e: The kings of various countries will engross themselves in sinful actions

562.g: ਨਰ ਲਾਜ ਛਾਡਿ ਨਿਲਾਜ ਹੁਐ ਫਿਰੈ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਸਬੈ ਭਗੇ ॥
562.t: nar laaj chhaadd nilaaj huaai firai dharam karam sabai bhage ||
562.e: The individuals will roam unashamedly, abandoning their shame the religious injunctions will speed away

562.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਜਹ ਤਹ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਾਰਾਜ੍ਯ ਪਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਹਰਖ ਹੈ ॥
562.t: kidhau soodhr jeh teh sarab meh mahaaraajay pai praharakh hai ||
562.e: Somewhere the Brahmins will touch the feet of Shudras

562.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਚੋਰ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਚੋਰ ਕੋ ਗਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਦਰਬ ਆਕਰਖ ਹੈ ॥੧੦੬॥
562.t: kidhau chor chhaadd achor ko geh sarab dharab aakarakh hai ||106||
562.e: Somewhere the thief will be released and a pious man will be caught and his wealth will be looted.106.

562.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
562.t: tirabha(n)gee chha(n)dh ||
562.e: TRIBHANGI STANZA

562.g: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਅਥਪਨ ਥਾਪੀ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰ ॥
562.t: sabh jag paapee kahoo(n) na jaapee athapan thaapee dhes dhisa(n) ||
562.e: The whole world will become sinful, there will be none performing austerities

562.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਮਤਵਾਰੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਰੇ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਉਜਿਯਾਰੇ ਬਾਧ ਰਿਸੰ ॥
562.t: jeh teh matavaare bhramat bhramaare mat na ujiyaare baadh risa(n) ||
562.e: In all countries the unestablishable things will be established the jealous persons will roam hither and thither

562.g: ਪਾਪਨ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਕੁਮਤਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਮਤ ਨੇਕੰ ॥
562.t: paapan ras raate dhuramat maate kumatan dhaate mat neka(n) ||
562.e: Absorbed in sinful activities many sects, originators of vices, will come in vogue

562.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ਚਿਤ ਲਲਚਾਵੈ ਕਛੁਹੂੰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਕੰ ॥੧੦੭॥
562.t: jeh teh uTh dhaavai chit lalachaavai kachhuhoo(n) na paavai bin eka(n) ||107||
562.e: Because of the greed in their mind, the people will run here and there, but they will not realise anything.107.

562.g: ਤਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਰਮੰ ਗਹਤ ਕੁਕਰਮੰ ਬਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਮੰ ਸਬ ਭਰਮੰ ॥
562.t: taj har dharama(n) gahat kukarama(n) bin prabh karama(n) sab bharama(n) ||
562.e: Leaving the religion of the Lord, all will adopt evil ways, but without the actions related to the Lord everything will be useless

562.g: ਲਾਗਤ ਨਹੀ ਤੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਫੁਰਤ ਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਬਿਨ ਮਰਮੰ ॥
562.t: laagat nahee ta(n)tra(n) furat na ma(n)tra(n) chalat na ja(n)tra(n) bin marama(n) ||
562.e: Without understanding the secret, all the mantras, yantras and tantras will become useless

562.g: ਜਪ ਹੈ ਨ ਦੇਵੀ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੀ ਆਦਿ ਅਜੇਵੀ ਪਰਮ ਜੁਧੀ ॥
562.t: jap hai na dhevee alakh abhevee aadh ajevee param judhee ||
562.e: The people will not repeat the Name of the supremely heroic, unconquerable and incomprehensible goddess

562.g: ਕੁਬੁਧਨ ਤਨ ਰਾਚੇ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਚੇ ਤਮਕ ਬੁਧੀ ॥੧੦੮॥
562.t: kubudhan tan raache kahat na saache prabheh na jaache tamak budhee ||108||
562.e: They will remain absorbed in wicked deeds and morbid intellect, being devoid of the grace of the Lord.108.

562.g: ਹੀਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
562.t: heer chha(n)dh ||
562.e: HEER STANZA

562.g: ਅਪੰਡਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਮੰਡਿਤ ਸੁਬੁਧਿਨਿ ਖੰਡਿਤ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥
562.t: apa(n)ddit gun ma(n)ddit subudhin kha(n)ddit dhekheeaai ||
562.e: The fools will become full of qualities and the wise will lose intellect

562.g: ਛਤ੍ਰੀ ਬਰ ਧਰਮ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਲੇਖੀਐ ॥
562.t: chhatree bar dharam chhaadd akaram dharam lekheeaai ||
562.e: The Kshatriyas, leaving the superb dharma, will consider the vices as the real dharma

562.g: ਸਤਿ ਰਹਤ ਪਾਪ ਗ੍ਰਹਿਤ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਚਹਤ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
562.t: sat rahat paap grahit krudh chahat jaaneeaai ||

562.g: ਅਧਰਮ ਲੀਣ ਅੰਗ ਛੀਣ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਪੀਣ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੦੯॥
562.t: adharam leen a(n)g chheen krodh peen maaneeaai ||109||
562.e: Devoid of truth, the sin and anger will receive respect and the individuals, absorbed in adharma and engrossed in anger will decline.109.

562.g: ਕੁਤ੍ਰੀਅਨ ਰਸ ਚਾਹੀ ਗੁਣਨ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਾਹੀ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
562.t: kutreean ras chaahee gunan na graahee jaaneeaai ||
562.e: Absorbed in the love of wicked women, the people will not adopt virtues

562.g: ਸਤ ਕਰਮ ਛਾਡ ਕੇ ਅਸਤ ਕਰਮ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
562.t: sat karam chhaadd ke asat karam maaneeaai ||
562.e: They will honour the wicked people, leaving aside the good conduct

562.g: ਰੂਪ ਰਹਿਤ ਜੂਪ ਗ੍ਰਹਿਤ ਪਾਪ ਸਹਿਤ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥
562.t: roop rahit joop grahit paap sahit dhekheeaai ||

562.g: ਅਕਰਮ ਲੀਨ ਧਰਮ ਛੀਨ ਨਾਰਿ ਅਧੀਨ ਪੇਖੀਐ ॥੧੧੦॥
562.t: akaram leen dharam chheen naar adheen pekheeaai ||110||
562.e: The groups of people, devoid of beauty, will be seen absorbed in sinful acts and will be under the impact of women devoid of dharma.110.

562.g: ਪਧਿਸਟਕਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
562.t: padhisaTakaa chha(n)dh ||
562.e: PADHISHTAKA STANZA

562.g: ਅਤਿ ਪਾਪਨ ਤੇ ਜਗ ਛਾਇ ਰਹਿਓ ॥
562.t: at paapan te jag chhai rahio ||

562.g: ਕਛੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਧਰਮ ਨ ਜਾਤ ਕਹਿਓ ॥
562.t: kachh budh bal dharam na jaat kahio ||
562.e: The sins have spread over the world and the intellect and religion have become powerless

562.g: ਦਿਸ ਬਦਿਸਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬੈ ॥
562.t: dhis badhisan ke jeea dhekh sabai ||

562.g: ਬਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੁ ਅਬੈ ॥੧੧੧॥
562.t: bahu paap karam rat hai su abai ||111||
562.e: The beings of various countries are engrossed in sinful acts.111.

562.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਤਮਾਨ ਨ ਨਰ ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਖ ਪਰੈ ॥
562.t: piratamaan na nar kahoo(n) dhekh parai ||

562.g: ਕਛੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕਰੈ ॥
562.t: kachh budh bal bachan bichaar karai ||
562.e: The people look like the stone-images and somewhere the dialogues are held with power of intellect

562.g: ਨਰ ਨਾਰਿਨ ਏਕ ਨ ਨੇਕ ਮਤੰ ॥
562.t: nar naarin ek na nek mata(n) ||

562.g: ਨਿਤ ਅਰਥਾਨਰਥ ਗਨਿਤ ਗਤੰ ॥੧੧੨॥
562.t: nit arathaanarath ganit gata(n) ||112||
562.e: There are many sects of men and women and the meaningful is always becoming meaningless.112.

562.g: ਮਾਰਹ ਛੰਦ ॥
562.t: maareh chha(n)dh ||
562.e: MAARAH STANZA

562.g: ਹਿਤ ਸੰਗ ਕੁਨਾਰਿਨ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਭਚਾਰਿਨ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਐਸ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥
562.t: hit sa(n)g kunaarin at bibhachaarin jin ke aais prakaar ||

562.g: ਬਡ ਕੁਲਿ ਜਦਪਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਬਹੁ ਛਬਿ ਬਿਗਸੀ ਤਦਿਪ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਿਭਚਾਰਿ ॥
562.t: badd kul jadhap upajee bahu chhab bigasee tadhip pria bibhachaar ||
562.e: People will love wicked and vicious women and undoubtedly the women may have taken birth in superior clans, but they will be indulging in fornication

562.g: ਚਿਤ੍ਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰੂਪ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
562.t: chitrat bahu chitran kusam bachitran su(n)dhar roop apaar ||

562.g: ਕਿਧੋ ਦੇਵ ਲੋਕ ਤਜਿ ਸੁਢਰ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥੧੧੩॥
562.t: kidho dhev lok taj suddar su(n)dharee upajee bibidh prakaar ||113||
562.e: The women multi-coloured like flowers and like delicate creepers will look like the heavenly damsels coming down.113.

562.g: ਹਿਤ ਅਤਿ ਦੁਰ ਮਾਨਸ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਸ ਨਰ ਹਰ ਅਰੁ ਬਟ ਪਾਰ ॥
562.t: hit at dhur maanas kachhoo na jaanas nar har ar baT paar ||
562.e: The men will look to their interest secretly and all will act like robbers

562.g: ਕਛੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਮਾਨਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਬੋਲਤ ਕੁਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥
562.t: kachh saasatr na maanat simirat na jaanat bolat kubidh prakaar ||
562.e: They will not accept the Shastras and Smritis and will only talk in uncivilized way

562.g: ਕੁਸਟਿਤ ਤੇ ਅੰਗਨ ਗਲਿਤ ਕੁਰੰਗਨ ਅਲਪ ਅਜੋਗਿ ਅਛਜਿ ॥
562.t: kusaTit te a(n)gan galit kura(n)gan alap ajog achhaj ||
562.e: Their limbs will decay because of leprosy and they will be subjected to fatal diseases

562.g: ਕਿਧੋ ਨਰਕ ਛੋਰਿ ਅਵਤਰੇ ਮਹਾ ਪਸੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਨਿਲਜ ॥੧੧੪॥
562.t: kidho narak chhor avatare mahaa pas ddolat pirathee nilaj ||114||
562.e: These people will roam on the earth unashamedly like animals as if they had come from hell and incarnated on earth.114.

562.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
562.t: dhoharaa ||
562.e: DOHRA

562.g: ਸੰਕਰ ਬਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਭਈ ਇਕ ਬ੍ਰਨ ਰਹਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
562.t: sa(n)kar baran prajaa bhiee ik bran rahaa na koi ||
562.e: All the subjects became hybrid and none of the castes had remained in tact

562.g: ਸਕਲ ਸੂਦ੍ਰਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਭੇ ਦਈਵ ਕਰੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੧੫॥
562.t: sakal soodhrataa praapat bhe dhieev karai so hoi ||115||
562.e: All of them obtained the wisdom of Shudras and whatever the Lord desires, will happen.115.

562.g: ਸੰਕਰ ਬ੍ਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਭਈ ਧਰਮ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਰਹਾਨ ॥
562.t: sa(n)kar bran prajaa bhiee dharam na katahoo(n) rahaan ||
562.e: There had been no remnant of dharma and all the subjects became hybrid

562.g: ਪਾਪ ਪ੍ਰਚੁਰ ਰਾਜਾ ਭਏ ਭਈ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਹਾਨਿ ॥੧੧੬॥
562.t: paap prachur raajaa bhe bhiee dharam kee haan ||116||
562.e: SORTHA the kings became the propagators of sinful acts the dharma declined.116.

562.g: ਸੋਰਠਾ ॥
562.t: soraThaa ||

562.g: ਧਰਮ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਰਹਾਨ ਪਾਪ ਪ੍ਰਚੁਰ ਜਗ ਮੋ ਧਰਾ ॥
562.t: dharam na katahoo(n) rahaan paap prachur jag mo dharaa ||
562.e: The dharma was not visible in the world and the sin greatly prevailed in the world

562.g: ਧਰਮ ਸਬਨ ਬਿਸਰਾਨ ਪਾਪ ਕੰਠ ਸਬ ਜਗ ਕੀਓ ॥੧੧੭॥
562.t: dharam saban bisaraan paap ka(n)Th sab jag keeo ||117||
562.e: Everyone forgot dharma and the whole world was drowned upto the throat.117.

563.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਚੜ੍ਯੋ ਅਸੰਭ ਜਗਤ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਚ ਹੈ ॥
563.t: kalijug chaRayo asa(n)bh jagat kavan bidh baach hai ||
563.e: The impossible Iron Age has come

563.g: ਰੰਗਹੁ ਏਕਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਤਬ ਛੁਟਿ ਹੋ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲ ਤੇ ॥੧੧੮॥
563.t: ra(n)gahu ekeh ra(n)g tab chhuT ho kal kaal te ||118||
563.e: In what way the world will be saved?’ till the time they are not imbued in the love of the one Lord, upto that time there will be no safety from the impact of the Iron Age.118.
HANSA STANZA

563.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਬਢਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਕਰਮ ॥
563.t: jeh teh baddaa paap kaa karam ||

563.g: ਜਗ ਤੇ ਘਟਾ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਭਰਮ ॥੧੧੯॥
563.t: jag te ghaTaa dharam kaa bharam ||119||
563.e: The sinful acts increased here and there and the religious karmas ended in the world.119.

563.g: ਪਾਪ ਪ੍ਰਚੁਰ ਜਹ ਤਹ ਜਗਿ ਭਇਓ ॥
563.t: paap prachur jeh teh jag bhio ||

563.e: The sin increased to a large extent in the world and the dharma took wings and flew away.120.

563.g: ਨਈ ਨਈ ਹੋਨ ਲਗੀ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਤ ॥
563.t: niee niee hon lagee nit baat ||

563.e: New things began to happen always and there were misfortunes here and there.121.

563.g: ਸਬ ਜਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਔਰ ਹੀ ਕਰਮ ॥
563.t: sab jag chalat aauar hee karam ||

563.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਘਟ ਗਇਓ ਧਰਾ ਤੇ ਧਰਮ ॥੧੨੨॥
563.t: jeh teh ghaT gio dharaa te dharam ||122||
563.e: The whole world began to perform the contrary karmas and the universal religion ended from the world.122.
MAALTI STANZA
Wherever you see, there are only people committing wicked deeds and no one who accepts religion is seen.123.
Upto the limit where we can see and listen, the whole world appears as sinner.124.
Because of vicious karmas, the dharma has fled away and no one talks about the Havana and yajna.125.
All have become wicked and unrighteous
There is no meditation anywhere and only the duality resides in their minds.126.
ATMAALTI STANZA

563.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਅਰਚਾ ॥
563.t: kahoo(n) na poojaa kahoo(n) na arachaa ||

563.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨ ਚਰਚਾ ॥
563.t: kahoo(n) na srut dhun si(n)mirat na charachaa ||
563.e: There is no worship and offerings anywhere

563.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਹੋਮੰ ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
563.t: kahoo(n) na homa(n) kahoo(n) na dhaana(n) ||

563.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੰ ॥੧੨੭॥
563.t: kahoo(n) na sa(n)jam kahoo(n) na isanaana(n) ||127||
563.e: There is no discussion about Vedas and Smritis anywhere there is no hom and charity anywhere and nowhere the restraint and bath are seen.127.

563.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਚਰਚਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਬੇਦੰ ॥
563.t: kahoo(n) na charachaa kahoo(n) na bedha(n) ||

563.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਤਸਬੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
563.t: kahoo(n) na tasabee kahoo(n) na maalaa ||

563.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਹੋਮੰ ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਜ੍ਵਾਲਾ ॥੧੨੮॥
563.t: kahoo(n) na homa(n) kahoo(n) na javaiaalaa ||128||
563.e: No discussion about Vedas, no prayer no Semitic scriptures, no rosary and no sacrificial fire are seen anywhere.128.

563.g: ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਕਰਮੰ ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਧਰਮੰ ॥
563.t: aaur hee karama(n) aaur hee dharama(n) ||

563.g: ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਭਾਵੰ ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਮਰਮੰ ॥
563.t: aaur hee bhaava(n) aaur hee marama(n) ||

563.g: ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਰੀਤਾ ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਚਰਚਾ ॥
563.t: aaur hee reetaa aaur hee charachaa ||

563.g: ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਰੀਤੰ ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਅਰਚਾ ॥੧੨੯॥
563.t: aaur hee reeta(n) aaur hee arachaa ||129||
563.e: The contrary religious actions, feelings, secrets, rites, customs, discussion, worship and offerings are only visible.129.

563.g: ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਭਾਤੰ ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
563.t: aaur hee bhaata(n) aaur hee basatra(n) ||

563.g: ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
563.t: aaur hee baanee aaur hee asatra(n) ||

563.g: ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਰੀਤਾ ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਭਾਯੰ ॥
563.t: aaur hee reetaa aaur hee bhaaya(n) ||

563.g: ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਉਰ ਹੀ ਨ੍ਯਾਯੰ ॥੧੩੦॥
563.t: aaur hee raajaa aaur hee nayaaya(n) ||130||
563.e: The strange clothes, speech, arms, weapons, rites, customs, love, king and his justice are visible.130.
ABHIR STANZA

564.e: The king and saints etc. engaged in evil acts and with sins in their hearts, they are doing disservice to dharma.131.
All the people have become cruel, characterless, sinners and hard-hearted
They do not remain stable even for half a moment and keep the desires of adharma in their mind.132.
They are extremely ignorant, sinners, doing disservice to dharma and without belief in mantras, yantras and tantras.133.
With the increase of adharma, dharma became fearful and fled away
New activities were introduced and the wicked intellect spread on all the four sides.134.

564.g: ਨਏ ਨਏ ਮਾਰਗ ਚਲੇ ਜਗ ਮੋ ਬਢਾ ਅਧਰਮ ॥
564.t: ne ne maarag chale jag mo baddaa adharam ||
564.e: Several new paths were initiated and adharma increased in the world

564.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਸਭੈ ਲਗੇ ਜਹ ਜਹ ਕਰਨ ਕੁਕਰਮ ॥
564.t: raajaa prajaa sabhai lage jeh jeh karan kukaram ||
564.e: The king and also his subject performed evil acts

564.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਕਰਨ ਕੁਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਨਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
564.t: jeh teh karan kukaram prajaa raajaa nar naaree ||
564.e: And because of such conduct of the king and his subject and the character of men and women

564.g: ਧਰਮ ਪੰਖ ਕਰ ਉਡਾ ਪਾਪ ਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਬਿਥਾਰੀ ॥੧੩੫॥
564.t: dharam pa(n)kh kar uddaa paap kee kriaa bithaaree ||135||
564.e: , The dharma was destroyed and the sinful activities were extended.135.

564.g: ਧਰਮ ਲੋਪ ਜਗ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਪਾਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਬਪੁ ਕੀਨ ॥
564.t: dharam lop jag te bhe paap pragaT bap keen ||

564.g: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਰਾਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਅਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਲੀਨ ॥
564.t: uooch neech raajaa prajaa kriaa adharam kee leen ||
564.e: The dharma disappeared from the world and the sins became prevalent apparently

564.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਪਾਪ ਕੀ ਲੀਨ ਨਾਰਿ ਨਰ ਰੰਕ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
564.t: kriaa paap kee leen naar nar ra(n)k ar raajaa ||
564.e: The king and his subject, the high and low, all of them adopted the activities of adharma

564.g: ਪਾਪ ਪ੍ਰਚੁਰ ਬਪੁ ਕੀਨ ਧਰਮ ਧਰਿ ਪੰਖਨ ਭਾਜਾ ॥੧੩੬॥
564.t: paap prachur bap keen dharam dhar pa(n)khan bhaajaa ||136||
564.e: The sin increased greatly and the dharma disappeared.136.

564.g: ਪਾਪਾਕ੍ਰਾਤ ਧਰਾ ਭਈ ਪਲ ਨ ਸਕਤਿ ਠਹਰਾਇ ॥
564.t: paapaakraat dharaa bhiee pal na sakat Thaharai ||

565.g: ਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੋ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰਿ ਰੋਵਤ ਭਈ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
565.t: kaal purakh ko dhiaan dhar rovat bhiee banai ||
565.e: The earth agonised by sin trembled and began to weep while meditating on the Lord

565.g: ਰੋਵਤ ਭਈ ਬਨਾਇ ਪਾਪ ਭਾਰਨ ਭਰਿ ਧਰਣੀ ॥
565.t: rovat bhiee banai paap bhaaran bhar dharanee ||

565.g: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੇ ਤੀਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਬਰਣੀ ॥੧੩੭॥
565.t: mahaa purakh ke teer bahut bidh jaat na baranee ||137||
565.e: Overburdened by the weight of sin, it lamented in various ways before the Lord.137.

565.g: ਸੋਰਠਾ ॥
565.t: soraThaa ||
565.e: SORATHA STANZA

565.g: ਕਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਸਮੋਧ ਬਹੁਰ ਬਿਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ ਕਰੀ ॥
565.t: kar kai piratham samodh bahur bidhaa pirathavee karee ||
565.e: The Lord instructed the earth and saw her off

565.g: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੋਗ ਭਾਰ ਹਰਣ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਨਿਮਿਤ ॥੧੩੮॥
565.t: mahaa purakh bin rog bhaar haran basudhaa nimit ||138||
565.e: He reflected on the measure to be adopted for finishing the burden of the earth.138.

565.g: ਕੁੰਡਰੀਆ ਛੰਦ ॥
565.t: ku(n)ddareeaa chha(n)dh ||
565.e: KUNDARIA STANZA

565.g: ਦੀਨਨ ਕੀ ਰਛਾ ਨਿਮਿਤ ਕਰ ਹੈ ਆਪ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
565.t: dheenan kee rachhaa nimit kar hai aap upai ||

565.g: ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਦਾ ਆਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੈ ਆਇ ॥
565.t: param purakh paavan sadhaa aap pragaT hai aai ||
565.e: For the protection of the helpless and suffering humanity the Lord Himself will take some measure and He will manifest Himself as the Supreme Purusha

565.g: ਆਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੈ ਆਇ ਦੀਨ ਰਛਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਣ ॥
565.t: aap pragaT hai aai dheen rachhaa ke kaaran ||

565.g: ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਧਰਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਉਤਾਰਣ ॥੧੩੯॥
565.t: avataaree avataar dharaa ke paap utaaran ||139||
565.e: For the protection of the lowly and for ending the burden of the earth, the Lord will incarnate Himself.139.

565.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਹ ਸਮੈ ਸਤਿਜੁਗ ਲਾਗਤ ਆਦਿ ॥
565.t: kalijug ke a(n)teh samai satijug laagat aadh ||

565.g: ਦੀਨਨ ਕੀ ਰਛਾ ਲੀਏ ਧਰਿ ਹੈ ਰੂਪ ਅਨਾਦਿ ॥
565.t: dheenan kee rachhaa le'ee dhar hai roop anaadh ||
565.e: At the end of the Iron Age and by the very beginning of Satyuga, the Lord will incarnate Himself for the protection of the lowly,

565.g: ਧਰ ਹੈ ਰੂਪ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਕਲਹਿ ਕਵਤੁਕ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
565.t: dhar hai roop anaadh kaleh kavatuk kar bhaaree ||

565.g: ਸਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਸਾਰਥ ਨਮਿਤ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥੧੪੦॥
565.t: satran ke naasaarath namit avataar avataaree ||140||
565.e: And will perform wonderful sports and in this way the incarnated Purusha will come for the destruction of the enemies.140.

565.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
565.t: savaiyaa chha(n)dh ||
565.e: SWAYYA STANZA

565.g: ਪਾਪ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਕਉ ਕਲਿਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਹਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: paap sa(n)booh binaasan kau kalikee avataar kahaavahige ||

565.g: ਤੁਰਕਛਿ ਤੁਰੰਗ ਸਪਛ ਬਡੋ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਕੰਪਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: turakachh tura(n)g sapachh baddo kar kaadd kirapaan ka(n)paavahige ||
565.e: For the destruction of the sins, he will be called the Kalki incarnation and mounting on a horse and taking the sword, he will destroy all

565.g: ਨਿਕਸੇ ਜਿਮ ਕੇਹਰਿ ਪਰਬਤ ਤੇ ਤਸ ਸੋਭ ਦਿਵਾਲਯ ਪਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: nikase jim kehar parabat te tas sobh dhivaalay paavahige ||
565.e: He will be glorious like a lion coming down from the mountain

565.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੪੧॥
565.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||141||
565.e: The town of Sambhal will be very fortunate because the Lord will manifest Himself there.141.

565.g: ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਲਖਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਲਜਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: roop anoop saroop mahaa lakh dhev adhev lajaavahige ||
565.e: Seeing his unique form, the gods and other will feel shy

565.g: ਅਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕੇ ਟਾਰਿ ਘਣੇ ਬਹੁਰੋ ਕਲਿ ਧਰਮ ਚਲਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: ar maar sudhaar ke Taar ghane bahuro kal dharam chalaavahige ||
565.e: He will kill and reform the enemies and start a new religion in the Iron Age

565.g: ਸਭ ਸਾਧ ਉਬਾਰ ਲਹੈ ਕਰ ਦੈ ਦੁਖ ਆਂਚ ਨ ਲਾਗਨ ਪਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: sabh saadh ubaar lahai kar dhai dhukh aa(n)ch na laagan paavahige ||
565.e: All the saints will be redeemed and no one will suffer any agony

565.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੪੨॥
565.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||142||
565.e: The town of Sambhal will be very fortunate, because the Lord will manifest Himself there.142.

565.g: ਦਾਨਵ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਬਡੇ ਰਣਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਨਿਸਾਨ ਬਜਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: dhaanav maar apaar badde ran jeet nisaan bajaavahige ||

565.g: ਖਲ ਟਾਰਿ ਹਜਾਰ ਕਰੋਰ ਕਿਤੇ ਕਲਕੀ ਕਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬਢਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: khal Taar hajaar karor kite kalakee kal kirat baddaavahige ||
565.e: After killing the huge demons, he will cause his trumpet of victory to be sounded and killing thousands and crores of tyrants, he will spread his fame as Kalki incarnation

565.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਤਹੀ ਤਿਤ ਧਰਮ ਦਿਸਾ ਲਖਿ ਪਾਪਨ ਪੁੰਜ ਪਰਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: pragaT hai jitahee tit dharam dhisaa lakh paapan pu(n)j paraavahige ||
565.e: The place where he will manifest Himself, the condition of dharma will begin there and the mass of sins will flee away

565.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੪੩॥
565.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||143||
565.e: The town of Sambhal will be very fortunate, because the Lord will manifest Himself there.143.

565.g: ਛੀਨ ਮਹਾ ਦਿਜ ਦੀਨ ਦਸਾ ਲਖਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਿਆਲ ਰਿਸਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: chheen mahaa dhij dheen dhasaa lakh dheen dhiaal risaavahige ||

565.g: ਖਗ ਕਾਢਿ ਅਭੰਗ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਹਠੀ ਰਣ ਰੰਗਿ ਤੁਰੰਗ ਨਚਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: khag kaadd abha(n)g nisa(n)g haThee ran ra(n)g tura(n)g nachaavahige ||
565.e: The Lord will get infuriated on seeing the pitiable plight of the talented Brahmins and taking out his sword, he will cause his horse to dance in the battlefield as a persistent warrior

565.g: ਰਿਪੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਅਜੀਤ ਅਭੀਤ ਬਡੇ ਅਵਨੀ ਪੈ ਸਬੈ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: rip jeet ajeet abheet badde avanee pai sabai jas gaavahige ||
565.e: He will conquer the great enemies, all will eulogise him on the earth

565.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੪੪॥
565.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||144||
565.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate, where the Lord will manifest Himself.144.

565.g: ਸੇਸ ਸੁਰੇਸ ਮਹੇਸ ਗਨੇਸ ਨਿਸੇਸ ਭਲੇ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: ses sures mahes ganes nises bhale jas gaavahige ||
565.e: Sheshnaga, Indra, Shiva, Ganesha, Chandra, all of them will eulogise Him

565.g: ਗਣ ਭੂਤ ਪਰੇਤ ਪਿਸਾਚ ਪਰੀ ਜਯ ਸਦ ਨਿਨਦ ਸੁਨਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: gan bhoot paret pisaach paree jay sadh ninadh sunaavahige ||
565.e: The ganas, the ghosts, fiends, imps and fairies, all of them will hail Him

565.g: ਨਰ ਨਾਰਦ ਤੁੰਬਰ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਜਛ ਸੁ ਬੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਬਜਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: nar naaradh tu(n)bar ki(n)nar jachh su been prabeen bajaavahige ||
565.e: Nara, Narada, Kinnars, Yakshas etc. will play on their lyres in order to welcome him

565.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੪੫॥
565.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||145||
565.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate, where the Lord will manifest Himself.145.

565.g: ਤਾਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਮੁਚੰਗ ਉਪੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਸੇ ਨਾਦ ਸੁਨਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: taal miradha(n)g mucha(n)g upa(n)g sura(n)g se naadh sunaavahige ||
565.e: The sounds of drums will be heard

565.g: ਡਫ ਬਾਰ ਤਰੰਗ ਰਬਾਬ ਤੁਰੀ ਰਣਿ ਸੰਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਬਜਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: ddaf baar tara(n)g rabaab turee ran sa(n)kh asa(n)kh bajaavahige ||
565.e: The tabors, the musical glasses, rababs and conches etc. will be played,

565.g: ਗਣ ਦੁੰਦਭਿ ਢੋਲਨ ਘੋਰ ਘਨੀ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਬੈ ਮੁਰਛਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: gan dhu(n)dhabh ddolan ghor ghanee sun satr sabai murachhaavahige ||
565.e: And hearing the sounds of large and small, the enemies will become unconscious

565.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੪੬॥
565.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||146||
565.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate, where the Lord will manifest Himself.146.

565.g: ਤੀਰ ਤੁਫੰਗ ਕਮਾਨ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਦੁਰੰਗ ਨਿਖੰਗ ਸੁਹਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: teer tufa(n)g kamaan sura(n)g dhura(n)g nikha(n)g suhaavahige ||
565.e: He will look splendid with bow, arrows, quiver etc

565.g: ਬਰਛੀ ਅਰੁ ਬੈਰਖ ਬਾਨ ਧੁਜਾ ਪਟ ਬਾਤ ਲਗੇ ਫਹਰਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: barachhee ar bairakh baan dhujaa paT baat lage faharaavahige ||
565.e: He will hold the lance and spear and his banners will wave

565.g: ਗੁਣ ਜੱਛ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਸੁ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਸਿੱਧ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧ ਸਬੈ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: gun ja'chh bhuja(n)g su ki(n)nar si'dh prasidh sabai jas gaavahige ||
565.e: The Ganas, Yakshas, Nagas, Kinnars and all famous adepts will eulogise Hiim

565.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੪੭॥
565.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||147||
565.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate, where the Lord will manifest Himself.147.

565.g: ਕਉਚ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਕਟਾਰਿ ਕਮਾਨ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਨਿਖੰਗ ਛਕਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: kauch kirapaan kaTaar kamaan sura(n)g nikha(n)g chhakaavahige ||
565.e: He will kill in very great numbers using his sword, dagger, bow, quiver and armour

565.g: ਬਰਛੀ ਅਰੁ ਢਾਲ ਗਦਾ ਪਰਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: barachhee ar ddaal gadhaa paraso kar sool tirasool bhramaavahige ||
565.e: He will strike blows with his lance, mace, axe, spear, trident etc. and use his shield

565.g: ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧਤ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਰਣ ਮੂਰਧਨ ਮੋ ਸਰ ਓਘ ਪ੍ਰਓਘ ਚਲਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
565.t: at krudhat havai ran mooradhan mo sar ogh progh chalaavahige ||
565.e: In His fury, He will shower arrows in the war

565.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੪੮॥
565.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||148||
565.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate, where the Lord will manifest Himself.148.

566.g: ਤੇਜ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਅਖੰਡ ਮਹਾ ਛਬਿ ਦੁਜਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਰਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: tej pracha(n)dd akha(n)dd mahaa chhab dhujan dhekh paraavahige ||

566.g: ਜਿਮ ਪਉਨ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਬਹੈ ਪਤੂਆ ਸਬ ਆਪਨ ਹੀ ਉਡਿ ਜਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: jim paun pracha(n)dd bahai patooaa sab aapan hee udd jaavahige ||
566.e: Seeing his powerful beauty and glory, the tyrants will flee like the leaves flying before the strong gust of wind

566.g: ਬਢਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਤ ਹੀ ਤਿਤ ਧਰਮ ਦਸਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਪਾਪ ਨ ਢੂੰਢਤ ਪਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: badd hai jit hee tit dharam dhasaa kahoo(n) paap na ddoo(n)ddat paavahige ||
566.e: Wherever He will go, the dharma will increase and the sin will not be seen even on seeking

566.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੪੯॥
566.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||149||
566.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate, where the Lord will manifest Himself.149.

566.g: ਛੂਟਤ ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨਿਨ ਕੇ ਰਣ ਛਾਡਿ ਭਟਵਾ ਭਹਰਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: chhooTat baan kamaanin ke ran chhaadd bhaTavaa bhaharaavahige ||

566.g: ਗਣ ਬੀਰ ਬਿਤਾਲ ਕਰਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਰਣ ਮੂਰਧਨ ਮਧਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: gan beer bitaal karaal prabhaa ran mooradhan madh suhaavahige ||
566.e: With the discharge of the arrows from His bow, the warriors will fall down is perplexity and there will be many powerful spirits and dreadful ghosts

566.g: ਗਣ ਸਿੱਧ ਪ੍ਰਸਿੱਧ ਸਮ੍ਰਿੱਧ ਸਨੈ ਕਰ ਉਚਾਇ ਕੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਨਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: gan si'dh prasi'dh samira'dh sanai kar uchai kai kirat sunaavahige ||
566.e: The famous ganas and adepts will eulogise Him by repeatedly raising their hands

566.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੫੦॥
566.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||150||
566.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate where the Lord will manifest Himself.150.

566.g: ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਅੰਗ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਨੰਗ ਲਜਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: roop anoop saroop mahaa a(n)g dhekh ana(n)g lajaavahige ||

566.g: ਭਵ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ ਭਵਾਨ ਸਦਾ ਸਬ ਠਉਰ ਸਭੈ ਠਹਰਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: bhav bhoot bhavikh bhavaan sadhaa sab Thaur sabhai Thaharaavahige ||
566.e: Seeing his charming form and limbs, the god of love will feel shy and the past, present and future, seeing Him, will stay at their place

566.g: ਭਵ ਭਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਵਾਰਨ ਕੌ ਕਲਿਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਹਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: bhav bhaar apaar nivaaran kau kalikee avataar kahaavahige ||
566.e: For the removal the burden of the earth, he be called Kalki incarnation

566.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੫੧॥
566.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||151||
566.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate, where the Lord will manifest Himself.151.

566.g: ਭੂਮ ਕੋ ਭਾਰ ਉਤਾਰ ਬਡੇ ਬਡਆਛ ਬਡੀ ਛਬਿ ਪਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: bhoom ko bhaar utaar badde baddaachh baddee chhab paavahige ||
566.e: He will appear magnificent after removing the burden of the earth

566.g: ਖਲ ਟਾਰਿ ਜੁਝਾਰ ਬਰਿਆਰ ਹਠੀ ਘਨ ਘੋਖਨ ਜਿਉ ਘਹਰਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: khal Taar jujhaar bariaar haThee ghan ghokhan jiau ghaharaavahige ||
566.e: At that time, very great warriors and persistent heroes, will thunder like clouds

566.g: ਕਲ ਨਾਰਦ ਭੂਤ ਪਿਸਾਚ ਪਰੀ ਜੈਪਤ੍ਰ ਧਰਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਨਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: kal naaradh bhoot pisaach paree jaipatr dharatr sunaavahige ||
566.e: Narada, ghosts, imps and fairies will sing His song of victory

566.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੫੨॥
566.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||152||
566.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate, where the Lord will manifest Himself.152.

566.g: ਝਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਜੁਝਾਰ ਬਡੇ ਰਣ ਮਧ ਮਹਾ ਛਬਿ ਪਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: jhaar kirapaan jujhaar badde ran madh mahaa chhab paavahige ||
566.e: He will look splendid in the battlefield after killing the great heroes with His sword

566.g: ਧਰਿ ਲੁਥ ਪਲੁਥ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਘਣੀ ਘਨ ਕੀ ਘਟ ਜਿਉ ਘਹਰਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: dhar luth paluth bithaar ghanee ghan kee ghaT jiau ghaharaavahige ||
566.e: Knocking down corpses upon corpses, He will thunder like clouds

566.g: ਚਤੁਰਾਨਨ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਚਰਾਚਰ ਜੇ ਜਯ ਸਦ ਨਿਨਦ ਸੁਨਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: chaturaanan rudhr charaachar je jay sadh ninadh sunaavahige ||
566.e: Brahma, Rudra and all animate and inanimate objects will sing the declaration of His victory

566.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੫੩॥
566.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||153||
566.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate, where the Lord will manifest Himself.153.

566.g: ਤਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਉਚਾਨ ਧੁਜਾ ਲਖਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਤ੍ਰਸਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: taar pramaan uchaan dhujaa lakh dhev adhev trasaavahige ||
566.e: Looking at His sky-reaching banner all the gods and others will become fearful

566.g: ਕਲਗੀ ਗਜਗਾਹ ਗਦਾ ਬਰਛੀ ਗਹਿ ਪਾਣਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: kalagee gajagaeh gadhaa barachhee geh paan kirapaan bhramaavahige ||
566.e: Wearing His aigrette and holding his mace, lance and sword in His hands, He will move hither and thither

566.g: ਜਗ ਪਾਪ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਕਉ ਕਲਕੀ ਕਲਿ ਧਰਮ ਚਲਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: jag paap sa(n)booh binaasan kau kalakee kal dharam chalaavahige ||
566.e: He will propagate His religion in the Iron age for destroying the sins in the world

566.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੫੪॥
566.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||154||
566.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate, where the Lord will manifest Himself.154.

566.g: ਪਾਨਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਭੁਜਾ ਰਣਿ ਰੂਪ ਮਹਾਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: paan kirapaan ajaan bhujaa ran roop mahaan dhikhaavahige ||

566.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਮਾਨ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਅਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਲਖਿ ਬਿਓਮ ਬਿਵਾਨ ਲਜਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: pratimaan sujaan apramaan prabhaa lakh biom bivaan lajaavahige ||
566.e: The mighty-armed Lord, taking up His sword in His hand will show His Superb Form in he battlefield and seeing His extraordinary glory, the gods will feel shy in the sky

566.g: ਗਣਿ ਭੂਤ ਪਿਸਾਚ ਪਰੇਤ ਪਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਤ ਕੇ ਗੀਤ ਗਵਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: gan bhoot pisaach paret paree mil jeet ke geet gavaavahige ||
566.e: The ghosts, imps, fiends, fairies, fairies, ganas etc. will together sing the song of His victory

566.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੫੫॥
566.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||155||
566.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate, where the Lord will manifest Himself.155.

566.g: ਬਾਜਤ ਡੰਕ ਅਤੰਕ ਸਮੈ ਰਣ ਰੰਗਿ ਤੁਰੰਗ ਨਚਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: baajat dda(n)k ata(n)k samai ran ra(n)g tura(n)g nachaavahige ||
566.e: The trumpets will sound at the time of war and they will cause the horses to dance

566.g: ਕਸਿ ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਗਦਾ ਬਰਛੀ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: kas baan kamaan gadhaa barachhee kar sool tirasool bhramaavahige ||
566.e: They will move taking with them the bows and arrows, maces, lances, spears, tridents etc.,

566.g: ਗਣ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਪਿਸਾਚ ਪਰੀ ਰਣ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬੈ ਰਹਸਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
566.t: gan dhev adhev pisaach paree ran dhekh sabai rahasaavahige ||
566.e: And looking at them the gods, demons, imps, fairies etc. will become pleased

566.g: ਭਲੁ ਭਾਗ ਭਯਾ ਇਹ ਸੰਭਲ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧੫੬॥
566.t: bhal bhaag bhayaa ieh sa(n)bhal ke har joo har ma(n)dhar aavahige ||156||
566.e: The town of Sambhal is very fortunate where the Lord will manifest Himself.156.

566.g: ਕੁਲਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
566.t: kulak chha(n)dh ||
566.e: KULAK STANZA

566.g: ਸਰਸਿਜ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
566.t: sarasij roopa(n) ||

566.g: ਸਬ ਭਟ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
566.t: sab bhaT bhoopa(n) ||

566.g: ਅਤਿ ਛਬਿ ਸੋਭੰ ॥
566.t: at chhab sobha(n) ||

566.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਗਨ ਲੋਭੰ ॥੧੫੭॥
566.t: mun gan lobha(n) ||157||
566.e: O Lord! Thou art the king of kings, most beautiful like lotus, extremely glorious and manifestation of the desire of the mind of the sages.157.

566.g: ਕਰ ਅਰਿ ਧਰਮੰ ॥
566.t: kar ar dharama(n) ||

566.g: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
566.t: parahar karama(n) ||

566.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਵੀਰੰ ॥
566.t: ghar ghar veera(n) ||

566.g: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਧੀਰੰ ॥੧੫੮॥
566.t: parahar dheera(n) ||158||
566.e: Forsaking good action, all will accept the enemy’s dharma and abandoning the forbearance, there will be sinful actions in every home.158.

566.g: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਪਾਪੰ ॥
566.t: jal thal paapa(n) ||

566.g: ਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੰ ॥
566.t: har har jaapa(n) ||

566.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਦੇਖਾ ॥
566.t: jeh teh dhekhaa ||

566.g: ਤਹ ਤਹ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੧੫੯॥
566.t: teh teh pekhaa ||159||
566.e: Wherever we shall be able to see, only sin will be visible everywhere instead of the Name of the Lord, both in water and on plain.159.

566.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਪੇਖੈ ॥
566.t: ghar ghar pekhai ||

566.g: ਦਰ ਦਰ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
566.t: dhar dhar lekhai ||

566.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਅਰਚਾ ॥
566.t: kahoo(n) na arachaa ||

567.e: Even after searching in every home, no worship and prayer and no discussion on Vedas will be seen or heard.160.
The vicious conduct will be visible in all the countries and there be meaninglessness instead of meaningfulness everywhere.161.
Evil action were committed throughout the country and everywhere there was injustice instead of justice.162.
All the people of the earth became Shudras and all were absorbed in base acts, there was only one Brahmin there who was full of virtues.163.
A Brahmin always worshipped that goddess, who had chopped the demon named Dhumarlochan into two parts, who had helped the gods and even saved Rudra.164.

567.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਸਰਨ ਜਗ ਮਾਤ ਜਾਇ ॥
567.t: tin gahee saran jag maat jai ||

567.e: That goddess had destroyed Shumbh and Nishumbh, who had even conquered Indra and made him poor, Indra had taken refuge with the mother of the world, who had made him king of the gods again.165.

567.g: ਤਿਹਿ ਜਪਤ ਰੈਣ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਜ ਉਦਾਰ ॥
567.t: teh japat rain dhin dhij udhaar ||

567.g: ਤਿਹ ਗਹਿਓ ਨਾਹ ਦਿਨ ਇਕ ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੧੬੬॥
567.t: teh gahio naeh dhin ik nihaar ||166||
567.e: That Brahmin worshipped that goddess night and day, who in her fury had killed the demons of the nether-world, that Brahmin had a characterless (prostitute) wife in his home, one day she saw her husband performing the worship and offerings.166.
Speech of the wife addressed to the husband :
”O fool! why are you worshipping the goddess and for what prupose you are uttering these mysterious mantras? Why are you falling at her feet and deliberately making an effort for going to hell?167.

567.g: ਕਿਹ ਕਾਜ ਮੂਰਖ ਤਿਹ ਜਪਤ ਜਾਪ ॥
567.t: keh kaaj moorakh teh japat jaap ||

567.g: ਨਹੀ ਡਰਤ ਤਉਨ ਕੋ ਥਪਤ ਥਾਪ ॥
567.t: nahee ddarat taun ko thapat thaap ||

567.g: ਦੈ ਹੈ ਨਿਕਾਰ ਤੁਹਿ ਬਾਧਿ ਦੀਪ ॥੧੬੮॥
567.t: dhai hai nikaar tuh baadh dheep ||168||
567.e: “O fool! for what purpose you are repeating her Name, and do you not have any fear while repeating her Name ? I shall tell the king about your worship and he will exile you after arresting you.”168.

That vile woman did not know that the Lord had incarnated Himself for the protection of the people with the wisdom of Shudras and for making the people cautious, the Lord had incarnated Himself as Kalki.169.

567.g: ਤਬ ਕੁੜ੍ਰਹੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਚਿਤ ਰੋਸ ਠਾਨਿ ॥
567.t: tab kuRrahee naar chit ros Thaan ||

567.e: He rebuked his wife, realizing her welfare and because of the fear of public discussion, the husband kept silent, on this, that woman got enraged and going before the king of the town of Sambhal, she related the whole episode.170.

567.g: ਤਿਹ ਗਹਾ ਕੋਪ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਰਾਇ ॥
567.t: teh gahaa kop kar soodhr rai ||

567.g: ਕੈ ਹਨਤ ਤੋਹਿ ਕੈ ਜਪ ਨ ਮਾਇ ॥੧੭੧॥
567.t: kai hanat toh kai jap na mai ||171||
567.e: She showed the worshipping Brahmin to the king and the Shudra king getting infuriated, arrested him and giving him the hard punishment, the king said, “I shall kill you, or you abandon the worship of the goddess.”171.

568.g: ਨਹੀ ਹਨਤ ਤੋਹ ਦਿਜ ਕਹੀ ਆਜ ॥
568.t: nahee hanat toh dhij kahee aaj ||

568.g: ਨਹੀ ਬੋਰ ਬਾਰ ਮੋ ਪੂਜ ਸਾਜ ॥
568.t: nahee bor baar mo pooj saaj ||

568.g: ਨਹੀ ਕਰਤ ਆਜ ਤੋ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੰਡ ॥੧੭੨॥
568.t: nahee karat aaj to ko dhukha(n)dd ||172||
568.e: “O Brahmin! throw away this material of worship in the water, otherwise I shall kill you today, abandon the worship of the goddess, otherwise I shall chop you into two parts.”172.
Speech of the Brahmin addressed to the king :

568.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਾਚ ਤੁਹਿ ਕਹੋ ਦੇਵ ॥
568.t: sun leh saach tuh kaho dhev ||

568.g: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਟੂਕ ਤਨ ਕੇ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
568.t: kiau na hoh Took tan ke hajaar ||

568.e: “O king! I am telling you the truth, you may cut me into two parts, but I cannot leave the worship of the without hesitation, I shall not leave the feet of the goddess.”173.

568.g: ਸੁਨ ਭਯੋ ਬੈਨ ਸੂਦਰ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ॥
568.t: sun bhayo bain soodhar su krudh ||

568.e: Hearing these words, the Shudra king fell upon the Brahmin like the demon Makraksha on the enemy, the blood gushed up from both the eyes of the Yama-like king.174.
That foolish king called his servants and said, “Kill this Brahmin.” Those tyrants took him to the temple of the goddess.175.

568.g: ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨ ਕਾਢਿ ਅਸਿ ਕੋ ਨਚਾਇ ॥
568.t: kar leen kaadd as ko nachai ||

568.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੇ ਦੇਨ ਤਿਹ ਤੇਗ ਤਾਨ ॥
568.t: jab lage dhen teh teg taan ||

568.g: ਤਬ ਕੀਓ ਕਾਲ ਕੋ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਨ ॥੧੭੬॥
568.t: tab keeo kaal ko bipr dhiaan ||176||
568.e: Tying the bandage before his eyes and tying his hands, they took out the glistening sword, when they were about to strike the blow with the sword, then that Brahmin remembered KAL (death).176.

568.g: ਜਬ ਕੀਯੋ ਚਿਤ ਮੋ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
568.t: jab keeyo chit mo bipr dhiaan ||

568.g: ਤਿਹ ਦੀਨ ਦਰਸ ਤਬ ਕਾਲ ਆਨਿ ॥
568.t: teh dheen dharas tab kaal aan ||

569.g: ਨਹੀ ਕਰੋ ਚਿੰਤ ਚਿਤ ਮਾਝਿ ਏਕ ॥
569.t: nahee karo chi(n)t chit maajh ek ||

569.g: ਤਵ ਹੇਤੁ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਨਿ ਹੈ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧੭੭॥
569.t: tav het satr han hai anek ||177||
569.e: When the Brahmin mediated on KAL (death), then he appeared before him and said, “Do not worry in your mind, I shall kill many enemies for your sake.”177.

Then a dreadful sound was heard from the basement of the temple and Kalki incarnation manifested Himself, he was long like the palm tree, He had bedecked His waist with quiver and he was riding on a beautiful horse.178.
There was a loud sound and the heroic spirits began to dance tying small bells round the ankles
The maces, tridents, quivers and lances swung and waved like the dark clouds of Sawan.179.

569.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸੈ ਹਥ ਉਤੰਗੀ ਖੰਡਾ ਧੂਹਿਆ ॥
569.t: trai sai hath uta(n)gee kha(n)ddaa dhoohiaa ||
569.e: The army (with Kalki) had worn beautiful garments and that three hundred hands long-sized Kalki drew out his double-edged sword
The horses sprung like leopards and began to rotate.180.

569.g: ਪੈਰੇ ਧਾਰ ਪਵੰਗੀ ਫਉਜਾ ਚੀਰ ਕੈ ॥
569.t: paire dhaar pava(n)gee faujaa cheer kai ||
569.e: The trumpets were sounded and the armies confronted each other, the warriors advanced through the armies
They sprang and revolved and the swords struck with jerks.181.
Seeing him, all ran away, everyone coveted to see him.182.
Seeing his powerful form, the sun is feeling shy and his effulgence is mocking the powerful light.183.
The persistent warriors in rage are inflamed like the furnace, the powerful group of warriors is even scoffing at the sun.184.
The soldiers of the king advanced in rage and they were holding their arms and weapons in their hands.185.
Imbued with the idea of fighting, getting enraged, the warriors riding the horses are swinging their arms and weapons.186.
In their fury, they are grinding their teeth and talking in themselves and filled with ego these warriors are discharging their arrows.187.

570.e: Kalki, getting infuriated caught hold of His axe in his long arms and with its slightest blow, four hundred warriors died and fell down.188.
The drums sounded, the horses swung and the warriors thundered.189.
The thundering warriors discharged arrows, their shields were raised and the rhythmic sound was heard.190.
The daggers glistened, the flaming fires blazed and the flames rose high.191.
The blood oozed out from the wounds, which demonstrated the zeal of the warriors, they ran and fell in the multitude.192.
The helmets broke, the drums sounded and the heavenly damsels danced in consonance with the tune.193.
The limbs were chopped, they fell down and because of the discharged arrows, the warriors were tossed about violently.194.
The warriors fought bravely and the cowards ran away, the heroic fighters were filled with anger and malice.195.
With the discharge of the arrows, the cowards ran away and the zeal was exhibited by the oozing wounds.196.
The limbs and corpses of the warriors engaged in war fell up and down.197.
The shields gleamed and seeing the chopped heads, Shiva began to dance and wear the rosaries of skulls.198.
The horses sprang and the warriors seeing the corpses and chopped heads got pleased.199.

571.e: The swords saturated with hot blood glistened and Shiva danced and laughed.200.
The warriors, getting together, began to discharge arrows and taking their gleaming shields they began to wed the heavenly damsels.201.
The intoxicated sound is rising from all the four sides and the chopped limbs are falling down in the battlefield.202.
The warriors are fighting with each other with great zeal and the musical instruments are being and played in the battlefield.203.
The tips of the arms and weapons are entering the bodies and the Kshatriyas are striking their arms and weapons in the battlefield.204.
The warriors falling on the earth and then swinging up and fighting are shouting for water.205.

572.e: The directions have disappeared by the discharge of arrows, the warriors are falling and the cowards are running away.206.
Shiva while dancing and playing his tabor is roaming and wearing the rosaries of skulls.207.
The heavenly damsels are dancing and with the dreadful fighting by warriors and running away by the cowards, there is a break in the tune.208.
The warriors fall on being struck by the arrows and the headless trunks of the warriors are being chopped through the middle.209.
The blood-spilling warriors are fighting with double zeal and with the blows of the arms, the canopies of the warriors being cut down, are falling.210.
The tips of the striking arms are piercing the bodies, the horses are neighing and the warriors are thundering.211.
The shields and the armours are being cut, the warriors are falling on the earth and getting up while swinging.212.
The hands have fought with hands, the young soldiers being chopped and the arrows, flying numerously are being planted in the bodies.213.

572.g: ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਧੁ ਜੋਧਣੰ ਬਰੰ ॥
572.t: anoop roop dhikh kai su kradh jodhana(n) bara(n) ||

572.g: ਸਨਧ ਬਧ ਉਦਿਤੰ ਸੁ ਕੋਪ ਓਪ ਦੇ ਨਰੰ ॥
572.t: sanadh badh udhita(n) su kop op dhe nara(n) ||
572.e: Seeing the unique beauty, the warriors are getting infuriated and wearing their weapons are reaching in the war-arena

572.g: ਚਹੰਤ ਜੈਤ ਪਤ੍ਰਣੰ ਕਰੰਤ ਘਾਵ ਦੁਧਰੰ ॥
572.t: chaha(n)t jait patrana(n) kara(n)t ghaav dhudhara(n) ||

572.g: ਤੁਟੰਤ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰਣੋ ਲਸੰਤ ਉਜਲੋ ਫਲੰ ॥੨੧੪॥
572.t: tuTa(n)t asatr sasatrano lasa(n)t ujalo fala(n) ||214||
572.e: The warriors are inflicting wounds from both the sides and are hoping to get the declaration of victory, with the breakage of weapons, their bright tips are being seen.214.

572.g: ਉਠੰਤ ਭਉਰ ਭੂਰਣੋ ਕਢੰਤ ਭੈਕਰੀ ਸੁਰੰ ॥
572.t: auTha(n)t bhaur bhoorano kadda(n)t bhaikaree sura(n) ||

572.g: ਭਜੰਤ ਭੀਰ ਭੈਕਰੰ ਬਜੰਤ ਬੀਰ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥
572.t: bhaja(n)t bheer bhaikara(n) baja(n)t beer suprabha(n) ||
572.e: The warriors rotating while roaming, are raising dreadful sounds, seeing the glory of the warriors, the cowards are running away

572.g: ਤੁਟੰਤ ਤਾਲ ਤਥਿਯੰ ਨਚੰਤ ਈਸ੍ਰਣੋ ਰਣੰ ॥
572.t: tuTa(n)t taal tathiya(n) nacha(n)t ieesrano rana(n) ||

572.g: ਖਹੰਤ ਖਤ੍ਰਿਣੋ ਖਗੰ ਨਿਨਦਿ ਗਦਿ ਘੁੰਘਰੰ ॥੨੧੫॥
572.t: khaha(n)t khatirano khaga(n) ninadh gadh ghu(n)ghara(n) ||215||
572.e: Shiva is engaged in Tandava dance and the daggers are colliding with one another producing various types of sounds.215.

572.g: ਭਜੰਤ ਆਸੁਰੀ ਸੁਤੰ ਉਠੰਤ ਭੈਕਰੀ ਧੁਣੰ ॥
572.t: bhaja(n)t aasuree suta(n) uTha(n)t bhaikaree dhuna(n) ||

572.g: ਚਲੰਤ ਤੀਛਣੋ ਸਰੰ ਸਿਲੇਣ ਉਜਲੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ॥
572.t: chala(n)t teechhano sara(n) silen ujalee kirata(n) ||
572.e: The sons of the demons, getting, frightened are running away and the sharp arrows are being discharged on them

572.g: ਨਚੰਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਜੋਗਣੰ ਚਚਕਿ ਚਉਦਣੋ ਦਿਸੰ ॥
572.t: nacha(n)t ra(n)g jogana(n) chachak chaudhano dhisa(n) ||

572.g: ਕਪੰਤ ਕੁੰਦਨੋ ਗਿਰੰ ਤ੍ਰਸੰਤ ਸਰਬਤੋ ਦਿਸੰ ॥੨੧੬॥
572.t: kapa(n)t ku(n)dhano gira(n) trasa(n)t sarabato dhisa(n) ||216||
572.e: The Yoginis are dancing in the fourteen directions and the Sumeru mountain are trembling.216.

572.g: ਨਚੰਤ ਬੀਰ ਬਾਵਰੰ ਖਹੰਤ ਬਾਹਣੀ ਧੁਜੰ ॥
572.t: nacha(n)t beer baavara(n) khaha(n)t baahanee dhuja(n) ||

572.g: ਬਰੰਤ ਅਛ੍ਰਣੋ ਭਟੰ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਚੀਨ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥
572.t: bara(n)t achhrano bhaTa(n) prabeen cheen suprabha(n) ||
572.e: All the warriors of Shiva are dancing and the heavenly damsels, after recognizing the fierce fighters are wedding them

572.g: ਬਕੰਤ ਡਉਰ ਡਾਮਰੀ ਅਨੰਤ ਤੰਤ੍ਰਣੋ ਰਿਸੰ ॥
572.t: baka(n)t ddaur ddaamaree ana(n)t ta(n)trano risa(n) ||

572.g: ਹਸੰਤ ਜਛ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬੰ ਪਿਸਾਚ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਨੰ ॥੨੧੭॥
572.t: hasa(n)t jachh ga(n)dhraba(n) pisaach bhoot pretana(n) ||217||
572.e: The witches in their fury are shouting and the yaskshas, gandharvas, imps, ghosts, fiends etc. are laughing.217.

572.g: ਭਰੰਤ ਚੁਚ ਚਾਵਡੀ ਭਛੰਤ ਫਿਕ੍ਰਣੀ ਤਨੰ ॥
572.t: bhara(n)t chuch chaavaddee bhachha(n)t fikranee tana(n) ||

573.g: ਡਕੰਤ ਡਾਕਣੀ ਡੁਲੰ ਭਰੰਤ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਤੰ ॥
573.t: ddaka(n)t ddaakanee ddula(n) bhara(n)t patr sronata(n) ||
573.e: The vultures flying and revolving, are devouring flesh and the vampires are drinking blood, filling it in their bowls

573.g: ਪਿਪੰਤ ਯਾਸਵੰ ਸੁਭੰ ਹਸੰਤ ਮਾਰਜਨੀ ਮ੍ਰਿੜੰ ॥
573.t: pipa(n)t yaasava(n) subha(n) hasa(n)t maarajanee miraRa(n) ||

573.g: ਅਟੁਟ ਹਾਸਣੋ ਹਸੰ ਖਿਮੰਤ ਉਜਲੋ ਅਸੰ ॥੨੧੮॥
573.t: aTuT haasano hasa(n) khima(n)t ujalo asa(n) ||218||
573.e: The female ghosts and fiends are laughing while drinking blood and the luster of the swords is being seen and the continued laughter is being heard in the battlefield.218.
The warriors fought, the arrows were discharged, the horses died and the fighters fell down.219.
The soldiers discharging their arrows and being absorbed in the war are fighting with various limbs.220.
The swords are broken, the limbs are heavenly damsels are roaming for wedding them.221.
The elephants are engaged in fighting with other elephants, the camels, very high, are absorbed in fighting with other powerful camels.222.
With the discharge of arrows, the warriors being chopped are falling on the ground, they are getting up again.223.
They are shouting “kill, kill” in all the four directions and bedecking themselves, they are striking their weapons.224.
There are seen many warriors able to confront the very great power and there are also seen those in helpless condition.225.
The warriors are challenging and are consciously striking blows.226.
The warriors of Shiraz sat down after feeling shy.227.
Kalki inspires them to get up and cause them to see, he revolves the sword and strikes its edge.228.

574.e: Where the warriors are fighting and the arrows are being discharged, there the warriors get up and their armours, being shattered are falling down.229.
The warriors falling down in the war-arena are ferrying across the ocean of fear and the heavenly damsels roaming in the sky, are wedding the warriors.230.
Listening to the musical instruments of the battlefield, the cowards are running away and abandoning the battlefield, they are feeling shy.231.
The warriors are again rotating and embracing death by fighting, they do not retrace even one step from the battlefield and are ferrying across the dreadful ocean of Samsara by dying.232.
In the dreadful war, the fourfold army was scattered into fragments and because of the infliction of wounds on the bodies of the warriors, their honour and respect declined.233.
Without retracing their steps even slightly, the warriors are fighting and in anger, they are besieging the army.234.

575.e: They fall down on the earth after dying and the women of gods are wedding them, the warriors getting enraged in their mind, do not retrace even one step.235.
Getting infuriated, the warriors do not run for two steps and fighting in anger, they fall on the ground.236.
Because of the sound of the musical instruments of the battlefield the clouds are feeling shy and the bedecked warriors are not retracing, even slightly.237.

The striking discs are shattering the glory and pride of the warriors, because of the dreadfulness of war, the Sumeru mountain has also trembled and the steam of the blood of the warriors is flowing.238.
The dreadful war is going on with terrible explosions and the horse-riders are fixing their columns of victory.239.
Holding their swords in fury, the warriors are fighting and fighting with the strength of their mind, they are not moving back.240.
The warriors are challenging and shouting, they are striking blows with their swords.241.
The warriors are raising their weapons and exhibitir them, they are revolving and striking them.242.
They are aiming at the target in fury and carrying the weapons, they are giving the relish of their edges the enemies.243.
There are thousands of staunch warriors.244.
The shouting and crying warriors have gathered, they are excited and being chopped they are falling and bowing down.245.
The soldiers are hesitatingly aiming their arrows on their targets.246.

576.e: The echoes are being heard and the arrows are being shot.247.
The embellished warriors are thundering and are not running away.248.
Taking up their bows, arrows and quivers, the charming warriors are fighting.249.
With the winking of their eyelids, the warriors are getting angry and giving jolts to one another while laughing.250.
The charming warriors are discharging their arrows patiently.251.
The warriors are fighting in retaliation and are grappling one another.252.
The warriors are challenging without getting tired, and they are penetrating forward.253.
The unchoppable warriors are being killed.254.
The warriors striking blows, are bowing, challenging and getting up again.255.
The arrows are being discharged, the warriors are fighting, the limbs are being split and the war is continuing.256.
The warriors are getting excited, the heavenly damsels are roaming and the sparks of fire coming out of the colliding swords.257.
The limbs are being splitted, all are absorbed in the war, the horses are dancing and the warriors are thundering.258.

577.e: The blows are being endured with pleasure, the warriors are falling down while swinging and thundering.259.
Contacting the numberless spirits, the warriors are lamenting, they are getting unconscious and falling down, the ghosts are dancing.260.
The warriors are fighting catching hold of arrows, the beauty is resplendent on all the faces and the heavenly damsels are looking at the warriors.261.
The warriors are fighting with the elephants after killing the enemies, they are running away after being hit by the arrows.262.
The warriors are lying down unconscious and in their fury, their hair have been loosened and their attires have been damaged.263.
The worriers have been destroyed while fighting with the elephants, the horses are roaming openly and the worriers are thundering. 264.
The heavenly damsels are roaming over the whole earth, on being hit by the arrows the warriors are embracing martyrdom.265.
With the discharge of the arrows the directions have been hidden from view and the swords are gleaming high up in the sky.266.
The ghosts, arising from the graves, are coming towards the battlefield, the warriors are thundering and the horses are running.267.
The warriors whose limbs have been chopped, are falling in the war arena and the intoxicated warriors are being killed.268.
The cries of “kill, kill” are being heard in all the four directions, the warriors are closing in and are not backing out.269.
They are striking blows with their lances, while shouting, the whiskers of those egoists are also charming.270.

578.e: The drums are being played and the warriors are shouting, the trumpets are sounding and the persistent warriors are fighting with one another.271.
The warriors are thundering, the horses are jumping, the arrows are being discharged and the fighters are going astray in the multitude.272.
Where the warriors are fighting in the battlefield, there is much pomp and show, when the lances are turned upside down, there appears a miracle (that all the warriors re killed).273.
Where the steel is colliding, there the warriors are thundering, the armours are colliding with the armours, but the warriors are not retracing even two steps.274.
Somewhere the horses are running, somewhere the warriors are thundering, somewhere the heroic fighters are fighting and somewhere the warriors with breaking of their helmets are falling down.275.

579.e: Where the warriors have gathered, there they are striking the blows of their arms, they are fearlessly chopping with their weapons and killing the fighters.276.
Somewhere there are cries of “kill, kill”, and somewhere the horses are springing, somewhere seeing the opportunity the army is being removed.277.
Somewhere the wounds are being inflicted and somewhere the army is being pushed, somewhere the bodies saturated with blood are falling on the earth.278.

579.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਰਣ ਅਰਧ ਮਹੂਰਤ ਉਦੰਡ ॥
579.t: eeh bidh machaa pracha(n)dd ran aradh mahoorat udha(n)dd ||

579.g: ਬੀਸ ਅਯੁਤ ਦਸ ਸਤ ਸੁਭਟ ਜੁਝਤ ਭਏ ਅਡੰਡ ॥੨੭੯॥
579.t: bees ayut dhas sat subhaT jujhat bhe adda(n)dd ||279||
579.e: In this way, the dreadful war continued for a short while and two lakhs and one thousand warriors died in this war.279.

When the king of Sambhal heard this, he, getting mad with anger turned black like the dark cloud, during the night, with his magic power, he, magnified his body to such an extent that head touched the sky.280.
With helmets on his head, he seems like the suns among the clouds, his powerful body is like Shiva, the Lord of Chandra, which is indescribable.281.
It seemed that the flames were rising and the king had worn the weapons like the Guru Dronacharya.282.
The warriors shouting “kill, kill” were coming near and with the blows of their arms and weapons, the wounds were being inflicted.283.
With the sound of the collision of the dagger with dagger, the fishes of water were getting agitated and on all the four sides, the arrows were being showered violently.284.
Wearing beautiful garments, the warriors are falling down and on all the four sides, the warriors of charming whickers, were absorbed in lamenting.285.
The arrows and swords of sharp edges are being struck and the warriors are moving inspite of the chopping of their limbs.286.

The flesh-eating beings are dancing and vultures and crows in the sky are getting pleased, the rosaries of skulls are being strung for the neck of Shiva and it seems that all have got intoxicated on drinking wine.287.

580.e: The warriors being chopped by chopped by the edges of the weapons and the blows of the arms, spilling their blood are getting unconscious and falling down.288.
The warriors, flowing in the current of anger, are striking dreadfully their weapons and with the collision of the bloody daggers they are being excited doubly.289.
The goddess, thirsty of blood, is laughing and her laughter is pervading on all the four sides like the illumination of her light.290.
The determined warriors are fighting taking up their shields and Shiva wearing his rosary of skulls is dancing, the blows of weapons and arms are being struck.291.
The patient warriors are discharging arrows by repeatedly pulling their bows and the swords are being struck like the flash of lightning.292.
The bloody daggers are colliding and with double excitement, the warriors are fighting, those elegant warriors are shouting “kill, kill”.293.
Pressing one another, the warriors are looking magnificent and the great warriors are inflicting wounds on one another.294.
The warriors are engaged like wrestlers among themselves and striking their weapons they are desiring for their victory.295.
The warriors are imbued with war and with double excitement, they are striking their bloody dagger.296.
The heavenly damsels are moving the sky and the warriors, greatly tired, are falling down, the sound of clapping is being heard and Shiva is dancing.297.
The sound of lamentation is rising in the battlefield and alongwith it, there is also shower of arrows, the warriors are thundering and the horses are running from this side to that side.298.
In this way, a dreadful war was waged and the ghosts, fiends and Baitals began to dance, the lances and arrows spread in the sky, and it appeared that the night had fallen during the day.299.

580.g: ਜੂਝ ਜੂਝ ਕਹੂੰ ਗਿਰੇ ਸੁਭਟ ਗਣ ॥
580.t: joojh joojh kahoo(n) gire subhaT gan ||

581.e: Somewhere the imps and fiends are dancing in the battlefield and somewhere after continued fighting the warriors have fallen in the war-arena, somewhere the Bhairavas are shouting loudly and somewhere the dreadful crows are flying.300.
The small and big drums, trumpets, flute etc., are all being played, the pipe and fife are also being played and the warriors, getting frightened, are running away.301.
Great warriors fell martyrs in that battlefield and there was commotion in the country of Indra, the lances and arrows spread in the world like the rushing forth of the clouds of Sawan.302.
Getting infuriated in many ways the warriors are discharging arrows by pulling their bows, whosoever is hit by these arrows, he leaves for heaven.303.
There are heaps of chopped limbs lying somewhere and somewhere there are lying arrows and swords, somewhere there are seen garments, somewhere lances and somewhere armours of steel.304.
The warriors are dyed in the colour of war like the kinsuk flowers, some of them are dying while fighting as if they are playing Holi.305.

582.e: Someone is coming running and is not retracing even two steps backwards, they are striking blows like playing Holi.306.
Now Kalki will get enraged and will knock down and kill a gathering of warriors, he will strike blows with various types of weapons and will destroy the groups of enemies.307.

The arrows contacting the armours will be discharged and in this war, the gods and demons will all confront one another, there will be showers of lances and arrows and the warriors will strike shouting “kill, kill” from their months.308.

He will take out his axe and sword and in his fury, he will strike the gods and demons, he will cause the corpses fall over corpses in the war-arena and seeing this, the fiends and fairies will get pleased.309.
The ganas of Shiva will roar and seeing them in affliction, all the people will run away, they will move in the war-arena discharging the arrows continuously.310.
The swords will collide with one another and seeing all this, the great warriors will thunder, the generals will march forward from both the sides and shout “kill, kill” from their mouths.311.
Ganas, Gandharvas and gods will see all this and will raise the sounds of “hail, hail”, the axes and swords will be struck and the limbs, being cut into halves, will fall,312.

The intoxicated horses imbued with war, will neigh and the sound of anklets and small cymbals will be heard, the generals of both the sides will fall upon each other and will glisten their swords, while holding them in their hands.313.

The groups of elephants will roar in the war-arena and seeing them, the clouds will feel shy, all will fight in anger and the canopies of chariots etc. will drop from the hands of the warriors very quickly.314.

The war-trumpets sounded in all the directions and the warriors raising shouts turned towards the war-arena, now in their fury, they will strike blows with their swords and will quickly inflict wounds on the warriors.315.

Taking out his sword in his hand and glistening it, Kalki will increase his approbation in the Iron Age, he will scatter the corpse upon corpse and aiming the warriors as targets, he will kill them.316.

The thick clouds will rush forth in the war-arena and in the winking of the eye, the arrows will be discharged, he will hold his swords and strike it with a jerk and the crackling noise of the arrows will be heard.317.

583.e: The elephants, horses, chariots and chariot-riders will be chopped and the warriors catching each other by their hair, they ill swing, there will be blows of legs and fists and the heads will be shattered with teeth.318.

The kings of the earth will re-array their armies and hold their bows and arrows, there will be fought a dreadful war in anger in both the directions and the warriors will obtain a place in heaven in the dreadful war.319.
The swords will clatter and the jingling of the steel armours will be heard, the sharp-edged weapons will produce knocking sounds and the Holi of the war will be played.320.
The lances will be struck from both sides and the matted locks of the warriors will roll in dust, the spears will collide while striking blows like the thundering of the clouds of Sawan.321.

The warriors grinding their teeth in anger will cause their horses to dance from both sides, they will discharged arrows from their bows in the war-arena and will cut the saddles of horses and the armours.322.

583.g: ਘਟਿ ਜਿਉ ਘਣਿ ਕੀ ਘੁਰਿ ਢੂਕਹਿਗੇ ॥
583.t: ghaT jiau ghan kee ghur ddookahige ||

583.e: The warriors will rush forth like clouds and will roam in all the ten directions, shouting,”kill, kill”, with their utterance of “kill, kill”, the heart of Sumeru mountain will all move.323.
Crores of elephants and horses and also the riders of elephants will die fighting. To what extent the poet will describe them? The ganas, gods and demons will all see and hail.324.

Lakhs of lances and arrows will be discharged and the banners of all colours will wave in the war-arena, the superb warriors will fall on the enemies taking their shields etc. and in all the ten directions the sound of “kill, kill” will be heard.325.

The armours etc. will be seen flying in the war and the warriors will pitch their column of praise, the lances and arrows will be seen shining in the war-arena, besides the warriors, the ghosts and fiends will also be seen shouting loudly in the war.326.
Somewhere the lances and the arrows will be seen striking the targets, many will be thrown in all the ten directions by catching them from their hair.327.

The warriors of red colour will be seen and the arrows will be struck like the rays of the sun, the glory of the warriors will be of different type and seeing them, the kinsuk flowers will also feel shy.328.

The elephants, horses and chariot-riders will fight in such numbers that the poets will not be able to describe them, their songs of praise will be composed and they will be sung till the end of four ages.329.

584.e: The stable warriors will fall upon their opponents from both sides and will shout “kill, kill” from their mouths, the weapons will strike from both sides and the volleys of arrows will be discharged.330.
The warriors will shout, the clouds will be shy, the armies will fight and the arrows will be discharged.331.
The warriors will be showered, there will be the twang of the bows, the sworeds will collide and the war will continue.332.
The earth will thrust in and become fearful, the warriors will run away without getting shy.333.
The ganas will see, they will hail, they will sing praises and smile.334.

585.e: The warriors will fulful their promises and will look beautiful, even the gods will feel shy from them in the war-arena.335.
In their fury, they will discharged arrows, during their fighting in the war, their swords will break.336.
The warriors will thunder, and not run away, they will strike their blows with swords and will knock down their enemies.337.
The horses will fight, the warriors will be killed and will ferry across the world-ocean.338.
The gods will see and hail: they will utter “Bravo, Bravo” and will be pleased in their mind.339.
The Lord is the cause of all victories and the remover of the enemies, He is the destroyer of the tyrants and is Full of Glory.340.
He is the giver of suffering to the tyrants and is the ornamentation of the world, the praiseworthy Lord is the punisher of the enemies.341.
He is the destroyer of the armies and is the striker of the sword, He is the creator of the world and also its supporter.342.
He is Bewitching and Glorious, He is the Affliction-Giver for the enemies and the world remembers Him.343.
He is the masher of the enemy and fulfiller of the promise, He showers the arrows with His bow.344.
He is the Fascinator of women, Glorious and elegant, He allures the mind like the clouds of Sawan.345.
He is the ornament of the world and is the sustainer of tradition, he is cool like the moon and bright-faced like the sun.346.

586.e: He comes and gives comfort and happiness, seeing he thick clouds, he gets pleased like the peacock.347.
He is Merciful Lord of the world, He is the ornament of the universe and the remover of suffering.348.
He is the allurer of women and most beautiful, seeing his charming eyes, the deer are getting shy.349.
His eyes are like the deer’s eyes and lotus, He is full of Mercy and Glory.350.
He is the cause of the Iron Age and the redeemer of the world, He is Beauty-incarnate and even the gods become shy on seeing Him.351.
Heis the worshipper of the sword and the Destroyer of the enemy, He is the giver of happiness and killer of the enemy.352.
He is the Yaksha of water and the fulfiller of the promise, He is the Destroyer of the enemy and the masher of his pride.353.
He is the creator and support of the earth and by pulling His bow, He showers the arrows.354.
He glorious with the elegance of lakhs of moons, He is the Fascinatior of women with His Glorious Elegance.355.
He has red colour, He supports the Earth and has infinite Glory.356.
He is the field of Refuge, the Killer of the enemy, Most Glorious and Most Charming.357.
His Beauty captivates he mind, He is the Cause of the causes of the world and is Full of Mercy.358.

587.e: He is of such Captivating Beauty as if He is the god of love, His Brightness defeats the moon’s glory.359.
He is the worshipper of the sword and the Destroyer of the enemy, He is the Lord bestower of the boon.360.
The warriors are fighting in the war and the arrows are being discharged, the horse-riders are fighting in the battlefield and in their fury, they are absorbed in fighting.361.
The dreadful fighting continues and the warriors have got enraged, the warriors are striking their lances and are dismounting the fighters from their horses.362.
The soldiers have discharged the arrows and the horses have been killed and the fast-moving horses jumped and ran away.363.
The battlefield was saturated with blood and the warriors became unconscious during their fight, the fighters arise, get enraged and strike blows in great excitement.364.
Shiva is dancing and the cowards are running away, the warriors are fighting and are being struck by the arrows.365.
The warriors are absorbed in fighting and the heavenly damsels are moving for wedding them, the warriors are looking at them and they are also fascinated by them.366.
Their beauty allures the lovers like falling in the well, wherefrom they can never come out, these heavenly damsels have also drowned themselves in the sexual love of the beautiful warriors.367.
The women are getting allured and there is brightness of their elegance, the warriors seeing them are playing on various kinds of musical instruments.368.
The women, full of beauty and lust are dancing and the warriors, getting pleased are wedding them.369.
The king, getting infuriated, manifested himself as KAL (death) and in his anger, quickly advanced forward.370.

588.e: The warriors shouted, the horses danced, the fighters died and the ghosts etc. became pleased.371.
The warriors were being killed and the cowards began to run away, the king also fell upon the opponents and the musical instruments of war were played.372.
The swords were broken and fires blazed, with the infliction of arrows the warriors ran hither and thither.373.
Seeing the war, the goddess Kali also pleased in the sky, the Bhairav and ghosts etc. also in the battlefield.374.

588.g: ਅਸਿ ਟੁਟੇ ਲੁਟੇ ਘਨੇ ਤੁਟੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
588.t: as TuTe luTe ghane tuTe sasatr anek ||

588.g: ਜੇ ਜੁਟੇ ਕੁਟੇ ਸਬੈ ਰਹਿ ਗਯੋ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਏਕ ॥੩੭੫॥
588.t: je juTe kuTe sabai reh gayo bhoopat ek ||375||
588.e: The swords broke and many weapons were shattered into bits, those warriors who fought, were chopped and ultimately only the king survived.375.

588.g: ਸੈਨ ਜੁਝਤ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਭਯੋ ਅਤਿ ਆਕੁਲ ॥
588.t: sain jujhat nirap bhayo at aakul ||

588.e: On the destruction of his army, the king extremely agitated went forward and came at the front

588.g: ਸੰਨਿਧ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧਤ ॥
588.t: sa(n)nidh havai chit mai at krudhat ||

588.g: ਆਵਤ ਭਯੋ ਰਿਸ ਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਜੁਧਤ ॥੩੭੬॥
588.t: aavat bhayo ris kai kar judhat ||376||
588.e: Getting extremely angry in his mind and moved forward in order to fight.376.

588.g: ਜੰਗ ਜੁਟਿਓ ਅਪਨੋ ਦਲ ਲੈ ਸਬ ॥
588.t: ja(n)g juTio apano dhal lai sab ||
588.e: Taking his other forces with him, he struck blows in many ways

589.g: ਬਾਜ ਉਠੇ ਤਹ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਗਾਰੇ ॥
589.t: baaj uThe teh koT nagaare ||

589.g: ਰੁਝ ਗਿਰੇ ਰਣ ਜੁਝ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩੭੭॥
