589.t: rujh gire ran jujh nihaare ||377||
589.e: Many trumpets sounded there and the onlookers of war, also fell down in fear.377.

589.g: ਚਾਮਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
589.t: chaamar chha(n)dh ||
589.e: CHAAMAR STANZA

589.g: ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੈ ਸਕੋਪ ਬੀਰ ਬੋਲਿ ਕੈ ਸਬੈ ॥
589.t: sasatr asatr lai sakop beer bol kai sabai ||

589.g: ਕੋਪ ਓਪ ਦੈ ਹਠੀ ਸੁ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਰੇ ਸਬੈ ॥
589.t: kop op dhai haThee su dhai kai pare sabai ||
589.e: All the warriors in their fury, took their arms and weapons in their hands, moved forward with persistence and shouting loudly fell upon the opponents

589.g: ਕਾਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਬਾਨ ਤਾਨਿ ਤਾਨਿ ਤੋਰ ਹੀ ॥
589.t: kaan ke pramaan baan taan taan tor hee ||

589.g: ਸੁ ਜੂਝਿ ਜੂਝ ਕੈ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਨੈਕੁ ਮੁਖ ਮੋਰ ਹੀ ॥੩੭੮॥
589.t: s joojh joojh kai parai na naik mukh mor hee ||378||
589.e: The pulled their bows upto their ears and discharged their arrows and without moving backward even slightly they fought and fell.378.

589.g: ਬਾਨ ਪਾਨਿ ਲੈ ਸਬੈ ਸਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਚਲੇ ॥
589.t: baan paan lai sabai sakrudh sooramaa chale ||

589.g: ਬੀਨਿ ਬੀਨਿ ਜੇ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਬੀਰਹਾ ਭਲੇ ॥
589.t: been been je le prabeen beerahaa bhale ||
589.e: Taking angrily there bows an arrows in there hand they moved and the worriers were killed silectivly

589.g: ਸੰਕ ਛੋਰ ਕੈ ਭਿਰੈ ਨਿਸੰਕ ਘਾਇ ਡਾਰ ਹੀ ॥
589.t: sa(n)k chhor kai bhirai nisa(n)k ghai ddaar hee ||

589.g: ਸੁ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਹੁਇ ਗਿਰੈਂ ਨ ਜੰਗ ਤੇ ਪਧਾਰ ਹੀ ॥੩੭੯॥
589.t: s a(n)g bha(n)g hui girai(n) na ja(n)g te padhaar hee ||379||
589.e: They were all fearlessly inflicting wounds and their limbs are falling down, but still they did not run away from the battlefield.379.

589.g: ਨਿਸਪਾਲਿਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
589.t: nisapaalik chha(n)dh ||
589.e: NISHPAALAK STANZA

589.g: ਆਨਿ ਸਰ ਤਾਨਿ ਅਰੁ ਮਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਰ ਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: aan sar taan ar maan kar chhor hee(n) ||

589.g: ਐਨ ਸਰ ਚੈਨ ਕਰਿ ਤੈਨ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਰ ਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: aain sar chain kar tain kar jor hee(n) ||
589.e: By pulling their bows, the warriors are proudly discharging their arrows and are uniting arrows with arrows discharging swiftly the later arrows

589.g: ਘਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗ ਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: ghaav kar chaav kar aan kar laag hee(n) ||

589.g: ਛਾਡਿ ਰਣਿ ਖਾਇ ਬ੍ਰਿਣ ਬੀਰ ਬਰ ਭਾਗ ਹੀਂ ॥੩੮੦॥
589.t: chhaadd ran khai biran beer bar bhaag hee(n) ||380||
589.e: They are striking blows with zeal and the great fighters also having been wounded are running away.380.

589.g: ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਧਿ ਅਰਿ ਧਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: krodh kar bodh har sodh ar dhaavahee(n) ||

589.g: ਜੋਧ ਬਰ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਧਰਿ ਬਿਰੋਧਿ ਸਰ ਲਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: jodh bar krodh dhar birodh sar laavahee(n) ||
589.e: The Lord (Kalki) is moving forward, killing the enemies angrily and consciously and is striking his arrows on the opponents

589.g: ਅੰਗ ਭਟ ਭੰਗ ਹੁਐ ਜੰਗ ਤਿਹ ਡਿਗਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: a(n)g bhaT bha(n)g huaai ja(n)g teh ddigahee(n) ||

589.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਣ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਤਨ ਭਿਗਹੀਂ ॥੩੮੧॥
589.t: sa(n)g bin ra(n)g ran sron tan bhigahee(n) ||381||
589.e: The warriors with chopped limbs are falling down in the battlefield and all their blood is oozing out from their bodies.381.

589.g: ਧਾਇ ਭਟਿ ਆਇ ਰਿਸ ਖਾਇ ਅਸਿ ਝਾਰਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: dhai bhaT aai ris khai as jhaarahee(n) ||

589.g: ਸੋਰ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਸਰ ਤੋਰ ਅਰਿ ਡਾਰਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: sor kar jor sar tor ar ddaarahee(n) ||
589.e: The warriors come in rage, strike the swords and are killing the enemies while shouting

589.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜਿ ਪੈ ਨ ਭਜਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਰਨ ਸੋਭਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: praan taj pai na bhaj bhoom ran sobhahee(n) ||

589.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਛਬਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੁਤਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਰ ਲੋਭਹੀਂ ॥੩੮੨॥
589.t: pekh chhab dhekh dhut naar sur lobhahee(n) ||382||
589.e: They breath their last, but do not abandon the battlefield and seem splendid in this way, the women of gods are getting allured on seeing their beauty.382.

589.g: ਭਾਜ ਨਹ ਸਾਜਿ ਅਸਿ ਗਾਜਿ ਭਟ ਆਵਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: bhaaj neh saaj as gaaj bhaT aavahee(n) ||

589.g: ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਧ ਹਰਿ ਜੋਧ ਅਸਿ ਲਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: krodh kar bodh har jodh as laavahee(n) ||
589.e: The warriors are coming being bedecked with their swords and on this side the Lord in his fury is recognizing the real fighters

589.g: ਜੂਝਿ ਰਣਿ ਝਾਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਣ ਦੇਵ ਪੁਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: joojh ran jhaal biran dhev pur paavahee(n) ||

589.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਕੈ ਗੀਤ ਕੁਲਿ ਰੀਤ ਜਿਮ ਗਾਵਹੀਂ ॥੩੮੩॥
589.t: jeet kai geet kul reet jim gaavahee(n) ||383||
589.e: After fighting and getting wounded, the warriors leave for abode of gods and there they are welcomed with songs of victory.383.

589.g: ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
589.t: naraaj chha(n)dh ||
589.e: NARAAJ STANZA

589.g: ਸਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਕੈ ਸਬੈ ਸਲਾਜ ਬੀਰ ਧਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: saaj saaj kai sabai salaaj beer dhaavahee(n) ||

589.g: ਜੂਝਿ ਜੂਝ ਕੇ ਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਲੋਕ ਲੋਕ ਪਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: joojh joojh ke marai pralok lok paavahee(n) ||
589.e: All the warriors getting bedecked are falling upon the enemy and after fighting in the war, they reach heaven

589.g: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ਹਠੀ ਅਘਾਇ ਘਾਇ ਝੇਲਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: dhai dhai kai haThee aghai ghai jhelahee(n) ||

589.g: ਪਛੇਲ ਪਾਵ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਅਰੈਲ ਬੀਰ ਠੇਲਹੀਂ ॥੩੮੪॥
589.t: pachhel paav na chalai arail beer Thelahee(n) ||384||
589.e: The persistent warriors run forward and endure the anguish of the wounds, their feet do not fall back and they are driving other warriors ahead.384.

589.g: ਕੋਪ ਓਪ ਦੈ ਸਬੈ ਸਰੋਖ ਸੂਰ ਧਾਇ ਹੈਂ ॥
589.t: kop op dhai sabai sarokh soor dhai hai(n) ||

589.g: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਜੂਝ ਹੈਂ ਅਰੂਝਿ ਜੂਝਿ ਜਾਇ ਹੈਂ ॥
589.t: dhai dhai joojh hai(n) aroojh joojh jai hai(n) ||
589.e: All the warriors are moving forward in anger and are embracing martyrdom in the battlefield

589.g: ਸੁ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਮੇਲ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ ਆਨਿ ਡਾਰਹੀਂ ॥
589.t: s asatr sasatr mel kai prahaar aan ddaarahee(n) ||

589.g: ਨ ਭਾਜਿ ਗਾਜ ਹੈ ਹਠੀ ਨਿਸੰਕ ਘਾਇ ਮਾਰਹੀਂ ॥੩੮੫॥
589.t: n bhaaj gaaj hai haThee nisa(n)k ghai maarahee(n) ||385||
589.e: Colliding their arms and weapons, they are striking blows and the stable warriors, who do not think of running away, are striking blows, persistently thundering fearlessly.385.

589.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਢੋਲ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਸਨਾਇ ਝਾਝ ਬਾਜ ਹੈਂ ॥
589.t: miradha(n)g ddol baasuree sanai jhaajh baaj hai(n) ||

589.g: ਸੁ ਪਾਵ ਰੋਪ ਕੈ ਬਲੀ ਸਕੋਪ ਆਨਿ ਗਾਜ ਹੈਂ ॥
589.t: s paav rop kai balee sakop aan gaaj hai(n) ||
589.e: The small and big drums, flutes, anklets etc. are creating sounds and the warriors firmly putting their feet on the earth are thundering angrily

589.g: ਸੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਬੂਝ ਕੈ ਹਠੀ ਅਰੂਝਿ ਆਨਿ ਜੂਝ ਹੈਂ ॥
589.t: s boojh boojh kai haThee aroojh aan joojh hai(n) ||

589.g: ਸੁ ਅੰਧ ਧੁੰਧ ਹੁਇ ਰਹੀ ਦਿਸਾ ਵਿਸਾ ਨ ਸੂਝ ਹੈਂ ॥੩੮੬॥
589.t: s a(n)dh dhu(n)dh hui rahee dhisaa visaa na soojh hai(n) ||386||
589.e: The persistent warriors recognizing others are entangled with them and there is such a run in the battlefield that the directions are not being comprehended.386.

589.g: ਸਰੋਖ ਕਾਲਿ ਕੇਸਰੀ ਸੰਘਾਰਿ ਸੈਣ ਧਾਇ ਹੈਂ ॥
589.t: sarokh kaal kesaree sa(n)ghaar sain dhai hai(n) ||

589.g: ਅਗਸਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਕੀ ਜਿਮੰ ਪਚਾਇ ਸੈਨ ਜਾਇ ਹੈਂ ॥
589.t: agasat si(n)dh kee jima(n) pachai sain jai hai(n) ||
589.e: The lion of the goddess Kali, in order to kill the army, is running angrily in this way and wants to destroy the army in this way just as the sage August had completely drunk the ocean

589.g: ਸੰਘਾਰਿ ਬਾਹਣੀਸ ਕੋ ਅਨੀਸ ਤੀਰ ਗਾਜ ਹੈਂ ॥
589.t: sa(n)ghaar baahanees ko anees teer gaaj hai(n) ||

589.g: ਬਿਸੇਖ ਜੁਧ ਮੰਡ ਹੈ ਅਸੇਖ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਾਜ ਹੈਂ ॥੩੮੭॥
589.t: bisekh judh ma(n)dd hai asekh sasatr baaj hai(n) ||387||
589.e: After killing the forces, the warriors are thundering and in the dreadful fight, their weapons are colliding.387.

589.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
589.t: savaiyaa chha(n)dh ||
589.e: SWAYYA STANZA

589.g: ਆਵਤ ਹੀ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੇ ਦਲ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਜ ਕਰੀ ਰਥ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਕੂਟੇ ॥
589.t: aavat hee nirap ke dhal te har baaj karee rath koTik kooTe ||

589.g: ਸਾਜ ਗਿਰੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਰਾਜ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਰ ਬਾਜ ਫਿਰੈ ਹਿਹਨਾਵਤ ਛੂਟੇ ॥
589.t: saaj gire nirap raaj kahoo(n) bar baaj firai hihanaavat chhooTe ||
589.e: On the arrival of the army of the king, the Lord (Kalki) chopped many elephants, horses and chariots, the horses bedecked by the king were roaming in the battlefield,

590.g: ਤਾਜ ਕਹੂੰ ਗਜਰਾਜ ਰਣੰ ਭਟ ਕੇਸਨ ਤੇ ਗਹਿ ਕੇਸਨ ਜੂਟੇ ॥
590.t: taaj kahoo(n) gajaraaj rana(n) bhaT kesan te geh kesan jooTe ||

590.g: ਪਉਨ ਸਮਾਨ ਬਹੈ ਕਲਿ ਬਾਨ ਸਬੈ ਅਰਿ ਬਾਦਲ ਸੇ ਚਲਿ ਫੂਟੇ ॥੩੮੮॥
590.t: paun samaan bahai kal baan sabai ar baadhal se chal fooTe ||388||
590.e: Somewhere neighing and somewhere the elephant were seen running, the warriors catching the hair of one another were engaged in fight with them, the arrows were being discharged like the wind and with them, the arrows were being discharged like the wind an

590.g: ਧਾਇ ਪਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਬੜੇ ਭਟ ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਸੰਭਾਰੇ ॥
590.t: dhai pare kar kop baRe bhaT baan kamaan kirapaan sa(n)bhaare ||

590.g: ਪਟਿਸ ਲੋਹਹਥੀ ਪਰਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਚਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਚਉਕ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ॥
590.t: paTis lohahathee parasaa kar krodh chahoo(n) dhis chauk prahaare ||
590.e: Holding their arrows, bows and swords the great warriors fell upon (the opponents), the warriors were striking blows from all the four directions, taking their swords, axes etc. in their hands

590.g: ਕੁੰਜਰ ਪੁੰਜ ਗਿਰੇ ਰਣਿ ਮੂਰਧਨ ਸੋਭਤ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਡੀਲ ਡਿਲਾਰੇ ॥
590.t: ku(n)jar pu(n)j gire ran mooradhan sobhat hai at ddeel ddilaare ||

590.g: ਰਾਵਣ ਰਾਮ ਸਮੈ ਰਣ ਕੇ ਗਿਰਿਰਾਜ ਨੋ ਹਨਵੰਤਿ ਉਖਾਰੇ ॥੩੮੯॥
590.t: raavan raam samai ran ke giriraaj no hanava(n)t ukhaare ||389||
590.e: There were groups of elephants fallen in the war on the side and support of their faces and they appeared like the mountains uprooted and thrown by Hanuman in the Rama-Ravana war.389.

590.g: ਚਓਪੁ ਚਰੀ ਚਤੁਰੰਗ ਚਮੂੰ ਕਰੁਣਾਲਯ ਕੇ ਪਰ ਸਿੰਧੁਰ ਪੇਲੇ ॥
590.t: chop charee chatura(n)g chamoo(n) karunaalay ke par si(n)dhur pele ||

590.g: ਧਾਇ ਪਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਹਠੀ ਕਰ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਬੈ ਪਗ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਨ ਪਿਛੇਲੇ ॥
590.t: dhai pare kar kop haThee kar kaaT sabai pag dhavai na pichhele ||
590.e: Taking the fourfold army, the Lord (Kalki) was attacked through elephants through the persistent warriors were chopped, but still they did not retrace their steps

590.g: ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨਨ ਕੇ ਘਨ ਸ੍ਯਾਮ ਘਨੇ ਤਨਿ ਆਯੁਧ ਝੇਲੇ ॥
590.t: baan kamaan kirapaanan ke ghan sayaam ghane tan aayudh jhele ||

590.g: ਸ੍ਰੋਨ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਮਣੀਅ ਰਮਾਪਤਿ ਫਾਗੁਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਬਸੰਤ ਸੇ ਖੇਲੇ ॥੩੯੦॥
590.t: sron ra(n)ge ramaneea ramaapat faagun a(n)t basa(n)t se khele ||390||
590.e: Enduring the blows of bows, swords and other weapons and dyed with blood, the Lord (Kalki) looked like one who had played Holi in the spring season.390.

590.g: ਘਾਇ ਸਬੈ ਸਹਿ ਕੈ ਕਮਲਾਪਤਿ ਕੋਪਿ ਭਰ੍ਯੋ ਕਰਿ ਆਯੁਧ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
590.t: ghai sabai seh kai kamalaapat kop bharayo kar aayudh leene ||

590.g: ਦੁਜਨ ਸੈਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਧਸਿ ਕੈ ਛਿਨ ਮੈ ਬਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਬੈ ਅਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
590.t: dhujan sain bikhai dhas kai chhin mai bin praan sabai ar keene ||
590.e: When wounded, the Lord was greatly enraged and he took his weapons in his hands, he penetrated into the army of the enemy and killed all of it in an instant

590.g: ਟੂਟ ਪਰੇ ਰਮਣੀ ਅਸ ਭੂਖਣ ਬੀਰ ਬਲੀ ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਚੀਨੇ ॥
590.t: TooT pare ramanee as bhookhan beer balee at su(n)dhar cheene ||

590.g: ਯੌ ਉਪਮਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਰਣ ਭੂਮਿ ਕੋ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਭੂਖਨ ਦੀਨੇ ॥੩੯੧॥
590.t: yau upamaa upajee man mai ran bhoom ko maanahu bhookhan dheene ||391||
590.e: He fell upon the warriors and he seemed splendidly beautiful as if the had given the ornaments of wounds to all the warriors in the battlefield.391.

590.g: ਚਉਪਿ ਚੜਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਕਲੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਆਯੁਧ ਅੰਗ ਅਨੇਕਨ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
590.t: chaup chaRio kar kop kalee kirat aayudh a(n)g anekan saaje ||

590.g: ਤਾਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਉਪੰਗ ਮੁਚੰਗ ਸੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਜੇ ॥
590.t: taal miradha(n)g upa(n)g mucha(n)g su bhaat anek bhalee bidh baaje ||
590.e: The Lord Kalki, bedecked his limbs with weapons, and in great rage, went forward, many musical instruments including drums were played in the war-arena

590.g: ਪੂਰਿ ਫਟੀ ਛੁਟਿ ਧੂਰ ਜਟੀ ਜਟ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਦੋਊ ਉਠਿ ਭਾਜੇ ॥
590.t: poor faTee chhuT dhoor jaTee jaT dhev adhev dhouoo uTh bhaaje ||

590.g: ਕੋਪ ਕਛੂ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਚਿਤ ਮੋ ਕਲਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਜਬੈ ਰਣਿ ਗਾਜੇ ॥੩੯੨॥
590.t: kop kachhoo kar kai chit mo kalakee avataar jabai ran gaaje ||392||
590.e: Seeing that dreadful war, the matted locks of Shiva were also loosened and both the gods and demons fled away, all this happened at that time when Kalki thundered in rage in the battlefield.392.

590.g: ਬਾਜ ਹਨੇ ਗਜਰਾਜ ਹਨੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਜ ਹਨੇ ਰਣ ਭੂਮਿ ਗਿਰਾਏ ॥
590.t: baaj hane gajaraaj hane niraparaaj hane ran bhoom giraae ||

590.g: ਡੋਲਿ ਗਿਰਿਓ ਗਿਰ ਮੇਰ ਰਸਾਤਲ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਸਬੈ ਭਹਰਾਏ ॥
590.t: ddol girio gir mer rasaatal dhev adhev sabai bhaharaae ||
590.e: The horses, elephants, and kings were killed in the battlefield, the Sumeru mountain trembled and thrust into the earth, the gods and demons both became fearful

590.g: ਸਾਤੋਊ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸੁਕੀ ਸਰਤਾ ਸਬ ਲੋਕ ਅਲੋਕ ਸਬੈ ਥਹਰਾਏ ॥
590.t: saatouoo si(n)dh sukee sarataa sab lok alok sabai thaharaae ||

590.g: ਚਉਕ ਚਕੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਗਪਾਲ ਸਬੈ ਕਿਹ ਪੈ ਕਲਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਰਿਸਾਏ ॥੩੯੩॥
590.t: chauk chake dhiragapaal sabai keh pai kalakee kar kop risaae ||393||
590.e: All the seven oceans and all the rivers dried up in fear all the people trembled, the guardians of all the directions were wonder-struck as to who had been attacked in anger by Kalki.393.

590.g: ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਸੰਭਾਰਿ ਹਠੀ ਹਠ ਠਾਨਿ ਹਠੀ ਰਣਿ ਕੋਟਿਕੁ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
590.t: baan kamaan sa(n)bhaar haThee haTh Thaan haThee ran koTik maare ||

590.g: ਜਾਘ ਕਹੂੰ ਸਿਰ ਬਾਹ ਕਹੂੰ ਅਸਿ ਰੇਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣ ਸਬੈ ਕਰਿ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
590.t: jaagh kahoo(n) sir baeh kahoo(n) as ren pramaan sabai kar ddaare ||
590.e: Holding his bow and arrows, Kalki, killed crores of enemies, the legs, heads and swords lay scattered at several places, the Lord (Kalki) rolled all in the dust

590.g: ਬਾਜ ਕਹੂੰ ਗਜਰਾਜ ਧੁਜਾ ਰਥ ਉਸਟ ਪਰੇ ਰਣਿ ਪੁਸਟ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
590.t: baaj kahoo(n) gajaraaj dhujaa rath usaT pare ran pusaT bidhaare ||

590.g: ਜਾਨੁਕ ਬਾਗ ਬਨਿਓ ਰਣਿ ਮੰਡਲ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਜਟਿ ਧੂਰ ਪਧਾਰੇ ॥੩੯੪॥
590.t: jaanuk baag banio ran ma(n)ddal pekhan kau jaT dhoor padhaare ||394||
590.e: The elephants, horses, chariots and camels were lying dead, it seemed that the battlefield had become and arrows and Shiva was looking for it, roaming hither and thither.394.

590.g: ਲਾਜ ਭਰੇ ਅਰਿਰਾਜ ਚਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੇ ਨਹੀ ਆਨਿ ਘਿਰੇ ॥
590.t: laaj bhare ariraaj chahoo(n) dhis bhaaj chale nahee aan ghire ||

590.g: ਗਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਗਦਾ ਬਰਛੀ ਛਟ ਛੈਲ ਛਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੌਪ ਚਿਰੇ ॥
590.t: geh baan kirapaan gadhaa barachhee chhaT chhail chhake chit chauap chire ||
590.e: The inimical kings, filled with shame ran in all the four directions and they again began to strike blows taking up their swords, maces, lances etc. with double zeal

590.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਮਾਨ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਭੁਜਾ ਕਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਪਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰੇ ॥
590.t: pratimaan sujaan ajaan bhujaa kar paij pare nahee fer fire ||

590.g: ਰਣ ਮੋ ਮਰਿ ਕੈ ਜਸ ਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਲਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਤਰੇ ॥੩੯੫॥
590.t: ran mo mar kai jas ko kar kai har so lar kai bhav si(n)dh tare ||395||
590.e: He, whosoever came to fight with that most powerful Lord, did not return alive, he died while fighting with the Lord (Kalki) and earning approbation, ferried across the Ocean of fear.395.

590.g: ਰੰਗ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੁ ਸੁਰੰਗੇ ਹੈ ਸਿੰਧੁਰ ਛੂਟੀ ਹੈ ਸੀਸ ਪੈ ਸ੍ਰੋਨ ਅਲੇਲੈ ॥
590.t: ra(n)g so jaan sura(n)ge hai si(n)dhur chhooTee hai sees pai sron alelai ||

590.g: ਬਾਜ ਗਿਰੇ ਭਟ ਰਾਜ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਿਚਲੇ ਕੁਪ ਕੈ ਕਲ ਕੇ ਅਸਿ ਕੇਲੈ ॥
590.t: baaj gire bhaT raaj kahoo(n) bichale kup kai kal ke as kelai ||
590.e: With the currents of blood, having fallen on them, the elephants are seen dyed in beautiful colour, the Lord Kalki, in his fury, wrought such a havoc that somewhere the horses have fallen down and somewhere the superb warriors have been knocked down

590.g: ਚਾਚਰ ਜਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਪਰ ਜੂਝਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਪਗ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਨ ਪਛੇਲੈ ॥
590.t: chaachar jaan karai basudhaa par joojh gire pag dhavai na pachhelai ||

590.g: ਜਾਨੁਕ ਪਾਨ ਕੈ ਭੰਗ ਮਲੰਗ ਸੁ ਫਾਗੁਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਬਸੰਤ ਸੋ ਖੇਲੈ ॥੩੯੬॥
590.t: jaanuk paan kai bha(n)g mala(n)g su faagun a(n)t basa(n)t so khelai ||396||
590.e: Though the warriors are definitely falling on the earth, but they are not retracing even two steps backwards, they all seen like the wrestlers playing Holi after drinking hemp.396.

590.g: ਜੇਤਕ ਜੀਤਿ ਬਚੇ ਸੁ ਸਬੈ ਭਟ ਚਓਪ ਚੜੇ ਚਹੁੰ ਓਰਨ ਧਾਏ ॥
590.t: jetak jeet bache su sabai bhaT chop chaRe chahu(n) oran dhaae ||

590.g: ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਗਦਾ ਬਰਛੀ ਅਸਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਏ ਕਰ ਮੋ ਚਮਕਾਏ ॥
590.t: baan kamaan gadhaa barachhee as kaadd le kar mo chamakaae ||
590.e: The warriors who warriors who survived, they attacked from all the four sides with greater zeal, taking their bows, arrows, maces, lances and swords in their hands, they glistened them

590.g: ਚਾਬੁਕ ਮਾਰਿ ਤੁਰੰਗ ਧਸੇ ਰਨਿ ਸਾਵਨ ਕੀ ਘਟਿ ਜਿਉ ਘਹਰਾਏ ॥
590.t: chaabuk maar tura(n)g dhase ran saavan kee ghaT jiau ghaharaae ||

590.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਲਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਲੈ ਕਰਵਾਰਿ ਸੁ ਏਕ ਹਨੇ ਅਰਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਪਰਾਏ ॥੩੯੭॥
590.t: sree kalakee kar lai karavaar su ek hane ar anek paraae ||397||
590.e: Whipping their horses and waving like the clouds of Sawan, they penetrated into the enemy’s army, but taking his sword in his hand, the Lord (Kalki) killed many and many and many fled away.397.

590.g: ਮਾਰ ਮਚੀ ਬਿਸੰਭਾਰ ਜਬੈ ਤਬ ਆਯੁਧ ਛੋਰਿ ਸਬੈ ਭਟ ਭਾਜੇ ॥
590.t: maar machee bisa(n)bhaar jabai tab aayudh chhor sabai bhaT bhaaje ||

590.g: ਡਾਰਿ ਹਥ੍ਯਾਰ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਸਨਾਹਿ ਸੁ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਾਰ ਭਜੇ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਜੇ ॥
590.t: ddaar hathayaar utaar sanaeh su ek hee baar bhaje nahee gaaje ||
590.e: When the dreadful war was waged in this way, the warriors fled away, leaving behind their weapons, they put off their armours and throwing their weapons fled and then they did not shout

590.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਲਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਤਹਾ ਗਹਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਬੈ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਿਰਾਜੇ ॥
590.t: sree kalakee avataar tahaa geh sasatr sabai ieh bhaat biraaje ||

590.g: ਭੂਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਰ ਚਕਿਓ ਛਬਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਦੋਊ ਲਖਿ ਲਾਜੇ ॥੩੯੮॥
590.t: bhoom akaas pataar chakio chhab dhev adhev dhouoo lakh laaje ||398||
590.e: Kalki, catching his weapons in the battlefield looks so charming that seeing his beauty, the earth, sky and nether-world were all feeling shy.398.

590.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਭਜੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਨਾ ਅਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਲਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਹਥ੍ਯਾਰ ਸੰਭਾਰੇ ॥
590.t: dhekh bhajee pratinaa ar kee kalakee avataar hathayaar sa(n)bhaare ||

590.g: ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਗਦਾ ਛਿਨ ਬੀਚ ਸਬੈ ਕਰਿ ਚੂਰਨ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
590.t: baan kamaan kirapaan gadhaa chhin beech sabai kar chooran ddaare ||
590.e: Seeing the army of the enemy running away, Kalki holding his weapons his bow and arrows, his sword, his mace etc., mashed everyone in an instant

590.g: ਭਾਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਭਟਾ ਜਿਮਿ ਪਉਨ ਬਹੇ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਪਾਤ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
590.t: bhaag chale ieh bhaat bhaTaa jim paun bahe dhrum paat nihaare ||

590.g: ਪੈਨ ਪਰੀ ਕਛੁ ਮਾਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਹਿ ਬਾਨਨ ਡਾਰਿ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਪਧਾਰੇ ॥੩੯੯॥
590.t: pain paree kachh maan rahio neh baanan ddaar nidhaan padhaare ||399||
590.e: The warriors ran away like the leaves before the blow of wind, those who took shelter, survived, the others, discharging their arrows fled away.399.

590.g: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਛੰਦ ॥
590.t: supriaa chha(n)dh ||
590.e: SUPRIYA STANZA

590.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਭਟ ਮਿਲਤ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰ ਉਚਾਰਤ ॥
590.t: kahoo(n) bhaT milat mukh maar uchaarat ||

591.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਭਟ ਭਾਜਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ਆਰਤ ॥
591.t: kahoo(n) bhaT bhaaj pukaarat aarat ||
591.e: Somewhere the warriors, gathering together, are shouting “kill, kill” and somewhere, getting agitated, they ae lamenting

591.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਜੋਧ ਫਿਰਤ ਦਲ ਗਾਹਤ ॥
591.t: ketak jodh firat dhal gaahat ||

591.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਜੂਝ ਬਰੰਗਨ ਬ੍ਰਯਾਹਤ ॥੪੦੦॥
591.t: ketak joojh bara(n)gan brayaahat ||400||
591.e: Many warriors are moving within their army and many after embracing martyrdom are wedding the heavenly damsels.400.

591.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬਰ ਬੀਰ ਫਿਰਤ ਸਰ ਮਾਰਤ ॥
591.t: kahoo(n) bar beer firat sar maarat ||

591.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਭਜਤ ਭਟ ਆਰਤ ॥
591.t: kahoo(n) ran chhodd bhajat bhaT aarat ||
591.e: Somewhere the warriors, discharging their arrows, are roaming and somewhere the afflicted warriors, leaving the battlefield, are running away

591.g: ਕੇਈ ਡਰੁ ਡਾਰਿ ਹਨਤ ਰਣਿ ਜੋਧਾ ॥
591.t: keiee ddar ddaar hanat ran jodhaa ||

591.g: ਕੇਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰ ਰਟਤ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਾ ॥੪੦੧॥
591.t: keiee mukh maar raTat kar krodhaa ||401||
591.e: Many are destroying the warriors fearlessly and many in their rage are shouting repeatedly “kill, kill”.401.

591.g: ਕੇਈ ਖਗ ਖੰਡਿ ਗਿਰਤ ਰਣਿ ਛਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
591.t: keiee khag kha(n)dd girat ran chhatree ||

591.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਭਾਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਤ੍ਰਸਿ ਅਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
591.t: ketak bhaag chalat tras atree ||
591.e: The daggers of many are falling having been shattered into bits and many wielders of arms and weapons are running away in fear

591.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਨਿਭ੍ਰਮ ਜੁਧ ਮਚਾਵਤ ॥
591.t: ketak nibhram judh machaavat ||

591.g: ਆਹਵ ਸੀਝਿ ਦਿਵਾਲਯ ਪਾਵਤ ॥੪੦੨॥
591.t: aahav seejh dhivaalay paavat ||402||
591.e: Many are roaming and fighting and embracing martyrdom are leaving for heaven.402.

591.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰਤ ਰਣ ਮੰਡਲਿ ॥
591.t: ketak joojh marat ran ma(n)ddal ||

591.g: ਕੇਈਕੁ ਭੇਦਿ ਚਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਲ ॥
591.t: keieek bhedh chale brahama(n)ddal ||
591.e: Many are dying while fighting in the battlefield and many after going through the universe are getting separated from it

591.g: ਕੇਈਕੁ ਆਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਤ ਸਾਗੈ ॥
591.t: keieek aan prahaarat saagai ||

591.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਭੰਗ ਗਿਰਤ ਹੁਇ ਆਂਗੈ ॥੪੦੩॥
591.t: ketak bha(n)g girat hui aa(n)gai ||403||
591.e: Many are striking blows with their lances and the limbs of many, being chopped, are falling down.403.

591.g: ਬਿਸੇਖ ਛੰਦ ॥
591.t: bisekh chha(n)dh ||

591.g: ਭਾਜਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਭਟ ਲਾਜ ਸਬੈ ਤਜਿ ਸਾਜ ਜਹਾ ॥
591.t: bhaaj binaa bhaT laaj sabai taj saaj jahaa ||

591.g: ਨਾਚਤ ਭੂਤ ਪਿਸਾਚ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ ਰਾਜ ਤਹਾ ॥
591.t: naachat bhoot pisaach nisaachar raaj tahaa ||
591.e: Many warriors abandoning their shame, and leaving behind everything, are running away, and the ghosts, fiends and imps dancing in the battlefield, are ruling over it

591.g: ਦੇਖਤ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਮਹਾ ਰਣ ਕੋ ਬਰਨੈ ॥
591.t: dhekhat dhev adhev mahaa ran ko baranai ||

591.g: ਜੂਝ ਭਯੋ ਜਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਰਥ ਸੋ ਕਰਨੈ ॥੪੦੪॥
591.t: joojh bhayo jeh bhaat su paarath so karanai ||404||
591.e: The gods and demons all are saying this that this war is dreadful like the war of Arjuna and Karan.404.

591.g: ਦਾਵ ਕਰੈ ਰਿਸ ਖਾਇ ਮਹਾ ਹਠ ਠਾਨ ਹਠੀ ॥
591.t: dhaav karai ris khai mahaa haTh Thaan haThee ||

591.g: ਕੋਪ ਭਰੇ ਇਹ ਭਾਤ ਸੁ ਪਾਵਕ ਜਾਨੁ ਭਠੀ ॥
591.t: kop bhare ieh bhaat su paavak jaan bhaThee ||
591.e: The persistent warriors, in their fury, are striking blows and they appear like the furnaces of fire

591.g: ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਭਰੇ ਰਣਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਜ ਅਤ੍ਰਣ ਝਾਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
591.t: krudh bhare ran chhatraj atran jhaarat hai ||

591.g: ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵ ਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੫॥
591.t: bhaaj chalai nahee paav su maar pukaarat hai ||405||
591.e: The kings in their ire are striking their weapons and arms, and instead of running away, they are shouting “Kill, Kill”.405.

592.g: ਦੇਖਤ ਹੈ ਦਿਵ ਦੇਵ ਧਨੈ ਧਨਿ ਜੰਪਤ ਹੈ ॥
592.t: dhekhat hai dhiv dhev dhanai dhan ja(n)pat hai ||

592.g: ਭੂਮ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲ ਚਵੋ ਚਕ ਕੰਪਤ ਹੈ ॥
592.t: bhoom akaas pataal chavo chak ka(n)pat hai ||
592.e: The gods and demons both are saying, Bravo!" Looking at the fighting, the earth, sky, neither-world and all the four direcitions trembling

592.g: ਭਾਜਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਬੀਰ ਮਹਾ ਰਣਿ ਗਾਜਤ ਹੈ ॥
592.t: bhaajat naahin beer mahaa ran gaajat hai ||

592.g: ਜਛ ਭੁਜੰਗਨ ਨਾਰਿ ਲਖੇ ਛਬਿ ਲਾਜਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੬॥
592.t: jachh bhuja(n)gan naar lakhe chhab laajat hai ||406||
592.e: The warriors are not running away, but are thundering in the war-arena, seeing the glory of those warriors the women of Yakshas and Nagas are getting shy.406.

592.g: ਧਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਰ ਸੂਰ ਤਹਾ ॥
592.t: dhaavat hai kar kop mahaa sur soor tahaa ||

592.g: ਮਾਡਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਕਰਾਰ ਭਯੰਕਰ ਜੁਧ ਜਹਾ ॥
592.t: maaddat hai bikaraar bhaya(n)kar judh jahaa ||
592.e: The great warriors, getting enraged, have attacked and are waging a dreadful and frightening war

592.g: ਪਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁ ਸਾਮੁਹਿ ਜੁਝਤ ਹੈ ॥
592.t: paavat hai sur naar su saamuh jujhat hai ||

592.g: ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਸਬੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਝਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੭॥
592.t: dhev adhev ga(n)dhrab sabai kirat sujhat hai ||407||
592.e: Embracing martyrdom in the ear, they are meeting the heavenly damsels and this war appears as a great war to all the gods, demons and Yakshas.407.

592.g: ਮਾਰਬੇ ਕੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਤਾਕਿ ਧਾਏ ਬੀਰ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ॥
592.t: maarabe ko taeh taak dhaae beer saavadhaan ||

592.g: ਹੋਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੁਧ ਕੇ ਜਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਸਬੈ ਬਿਧਾਨ ॥
592.t: hon laage judh ke jahaa tahaa sabai bidhaan ||
592.e: In order to kill Kalki, the warriors cautiously marched forward and began to wage war here, there and everywhere

592.g: ਭੀਮ ਭਾਤਿ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ਨਿਸੰਕ ਘਾਇ ਕਰਤ ਆਇ ॥
592.t: bheem bhaat dhai kai nisa(n)k ghai karat aai ||

592.g: ਜੂਝਿ ਜੂਝ ਕੈ ਮਰੈ ਸੁ ਦੇਵ ਲੋਕਿ ਬਸਤ ਜਾਇ ॥੪੦੮॥
592.t: joojh joojh kai marai su dhev lok basat jai ||408||
592.e: The brave warriors like Bhima are fearlessly striking blows and after fighting and embracing martyrdom, they are getting abode in the region of gods.408.

592.g: ਤਾਨਿ ਤਾਨਿ ਬਾਨ ਕੋ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਬਾਹ ਧਾਵਹੀ ॥
592.t: taan taan baan ko ajaan baeh dhaavahee ||

592.g: ਜੂਝਿ ਜੂਝ ਕੈ ਮਰੈ ਅਲੋਕ ਲੋਕ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥
592.t: joojh joojh kai marai alok lok paavahee ||
592.e: Pulling their bows and discharging arrows, they are advancing towards the Lord (Kalki) and embracing martyrdom, they are going to the next world

592.g: ਰੰਗ ਜੰਗਿ ਅੰਗ ਨੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਅੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਤ ॥
592.t: ra(n)g ja(n)g a(n)g na(n)g bha(n)g a(n)g hoi parat ||

592.g: ਟੂਕਿ ਟੂਕਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਿਰੈ ਸੁ ਦੇਵ ਸੁੰਦ੍ਰੀਨਿ ਬਰਤ ॥੪੦੯॥
592.t: Took Took hoi girai su dhev su(n)dhreen barat ||409||
592.e: They are absorbed in fighting and are falling into bits before him, these warriors are falling into bits for the sake of heavenly damsels and are embracing death.409.
The arrows of the warriors are crackling and the drums are rolling.410.
The horses are neighing and the elephants are trumpeting in groups.411.
The warriors are discharging arrows forcefully.412.
The ghosts intoxicated in the hue of war, are dancing, in the battlefield.413.
The sky is filled with heavenly damsels and they are all dancing.4.14.
The swords are gleaming quickly and they are striking with clattering sound.415.
The warriors are fighting in anger and are dying.416.

593.e: The horses and horse-riders are lying unconscious in the battlefield.417.
The elephants are running away and in this way, the kings, because of the disgrace of defeat, are feeling ashamed.418.
The large daggers are striking blows on the limbs in the war-arena.419.
In this way, innumerable army fought and the warriors, in anger, and discharging arrows and thundering advanced forward, hearing the dreadful sound, the cowards ran away.420.

The warriors, in anger , marched forward with their contingents and taking out their swords, they bean to strike blows, the heaps of the corpses looked like the mountains lying on the sea-cost for building the dam.421.

The limbs are being chopped, the wounds are oozing our and the warriors are fighting full of zeal, the adepts, minstrels and ballad-singers etc. are looking at the fighting and are also singing the praises of the heroes.422.

Shiva, assuming his dreadful form, is dancing and his frightening tabor is being played, the goddess Kali is stringing the rosaries of skulls and is releasing the fire-flames, while drinking blood.423.
The dreadful war-drums sounded, hearing which the cloud felt shy, the Kshatriyas fought in the battlefield and pulling their bows, discharged the arrows.424.
The warriors, with the broken limbs, fell while dancing, being absorbed in fighting, the fighters drew out their daggers with double zeal.425.
Such a terrible war was fought, that none of the fighters remained in senses, Kalki, the manifestation of Yama, was victorious and all the kings fled away.426.
When all the kings fled away, then the king (of Sambhal) himself rotated and came in front and producing the terrible sound, he began the fighting.427.
He was discharging his arrows as if the leaves were flying in the forest or the stars were falling from the sky.428.

594.e: He caused great loss to the enemies with his arrows, the arrows of the great warriors were discharged from all the four sides.429.
The arrows flew like the innumerable worms and locusts and they were countless in numbers like the particles of sand and the hair of the body.430.
The arrows, with golden wings and steel tips, were discharged and in this way, the arrows with sharp tips were discharged on the Kshatriyas.431.
The warriors began to fall in the battlefield and the ghosts and fiends danced, the fighters, getting pleased, showered arrows.432.
The warriors challenging others in fury, inflicted wounds on them, with the collision of dagger with the dagger, the sparks of fire were emited.433.
The horses danced and the ghosts roamed, the fiends, laughingly were absorbed in war.434.
Shiva also fought, while dancing, and in this way, for ten days, this ire-full war was fought.435.
Then the king, abandoning his spirit of bravery, ran for two steps, but then he rotated like the revengful snake.436.
Then he again began the war and showered arrows, the warriors discharged arrows and the death released them from the terror of the war.437.
All the adepts saw Kalki and repeated “bravo, bravo”, the cowards trembled on seeing him.438.

594.g: ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਸੰਧਾਨਿ ਬਾਨ ਧਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
594.t: aan aan sooramaa sa(n)dhaan baan dhaavahee(n) ||

594.g: ਰੂਝਿ ਜੂਝ ਕੈ ਮਰੈ ਸੁ ਦੇਵ ਨਾਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
594.t: roojh joojh kai marai su dhev naar paavahee(n) ||
594.e: The warriors aiming the targets of their arrows marched forward and embracing martyrdom in the war, they wedded the heavenly damsels

594.g: ਸੁ ਰੀਝਿ ਰੀਝਿ ਅਛਰਾ ਅਲਛ ਸੂਰਣੋ ਬਰੈਂ ॥
594.t: s reejh reejh achharaa alachh soorano barai(n) ||

594.g: ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਬੀਨਿ ਬੀਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਧੀਨ ਪਾਨਿ ਕੈ ਧਰੈਂ ॥੪੩੯॥
594.t: prabeen been been kai sudheen paan kai dharai(n) ||439||
594.e: The heavenly damsels, also being pleased, began to wed the warriors catching their hands after selecting them.439.

594.g: ਸਨਧ ਬਧ ਅਧ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਬਿਰੁਧਿ ਸੂਰ ਧਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
594.t: sanadh badh adh havai birudh soor dhaavahee(n) ||

594.g: ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸਾਗ ਤੀਛਣੰ ਕਿ ਤਾਕਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਲਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
594.t: s krodh saag teechhana(n) k taak satr laavahee(n) ||
594.e: The warriors, getting bedecked, fell on the direction of the opponents and striking sharp lances on the enemies

594.g: ਸੁ ਜੂਝਿ ਜੂਝ ਕੈ ਗਿਰੈ ਅਲੂਝ ਲੂਝ ਕੈ ਹਠੀਂ ॥
594.t: s joojh joojh kai girai aloojh loojh kai haThee(n) ||

595.g: ਅਬੂਝ ਓਰਿ ਧਾਵਹੀ ਬਨਾਇ ਸੈਨ ਏਕਠੀਂ ॥੪੪੦॥
595.t: aboojh or dhaavahee banai sain ekaThee(n) ||440||
595.e: The persistent fighters are falling down after continued fighting and gathering their forces, are running in various directions here and there.440.
The king trembled, the dreadful war-drums sounded, the elephants went out of control and the warriors fought with one-another.441.
The trumpets sounded and the warriors were killed, the bloody fighters fell and their zeal doubled.442.
The adepts laughed and the groups of warriors ran away, the arrows were discharged and the warriors fought among themselves.443.
There was the sound of arrows and the trumpets sounded, the kettledrums were played and the armies roamed.444.
The cowards trembled and were killed in the battlefield, Many of them speedily ran away and felt shameful in their mind. 445.

596.e: The king was released and he ran away alongwith his army, with the discharge of arrows all the directions were covered.446.
By discharging the arrows, the pride of all was mashed, with the infliction of arrows all the warriors were weakened, their weapons fell down from their hands.447.
The flowers were showered from the sky and in this way, the trouble ended, the kalki incarnation in his fury, killed the king.448.
The gods came from the front and catching the feet of the Lord (Kalki) eulogized him, the adepts also composed epics in Praise of the Lord.449.
For eulogizing the Lord, the epics were sung and the praise of the Lord spread in all the four sides, the pious people began pilgrimages and the true devotees of the Lord began to dance.450.

596.g: ਤਜਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਬ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥੪੫੧॥
596.t: taj sasatr sarab havai chit niraas ||451||
596.e: Ultimately, the king of Sambhal was killed, the small and large drums sounded, the warriors, frightened of war ran away and getting disappointed, they abandoned all the weapons.451.

596.g: ਹੋਵੰਤ ਜਗ ਜਹ ਤਹ ਸੁ ਇਸਟ ॥
596.t: hova(n)t jag jeh teh su isaT ||

596.e: The gods showered flowers and everywhere the patron-god was worshipped, the people adored the dreadful goddess and many works were finalized.452.

596.g: ਜਗ ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਜਗਿ ਆਦਿ ਦਾਨ ॥
596.t: jag dhoop dheep jag aadh dhaan ||

596.e: The beggars received charity and everywhere the poems were composed, the Yajnas, burning of incense, lighting of lamps, the charities etc. were all done according to vedic rites.453.

596.g: ਤਜਿ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਮ ਜਹ ਤਹ ਮਹੰਤ ॥
596.t: taj sarab kaam jeh teh maha(n)t ||

596.e: The heads of hermitages, leaving all other works, worshipped the goddess, the powerful goddess was established again and in this way, there was propagation of the perfect Dharma.454.

596.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਕਲਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸੰਭਰ ਨਰੇਸ ਬਧਹ ਬਿਜਯ ਭਏਤ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਧਿਆਇ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧॥
596.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the kalakee avataar sa(n)bhar nares badheh bijay bhet naam pratham dhiaai baranana(n) samaapata(n) sat subham sat ||1||
596.e: End of the chapter entitled “the Kalki Incarnation after killing the king of Sambhal becomes victorious-the description of the war of Sambhal” Bachittar Natak.
Now begins the description of war with various countries.
The king of Sambhal was killed and there was discussion regarding dharma in all the four directions, people made offerings to Kalki.455.
While the whole of the country was conquered, kalki got infuriated and he reddening his eyes, called all his army.456.

597.e: He sounded the horn of victory and he planted the column of war again, the whole army in great zeal, marched forward and the whole earth trembled.457.
The earth trembled like the boat in water, the warriors moved with great excitement and the atmosphere was filled with dust on all the sides.458.
All those who had canopies over their heads, got infuriated, taking with them all their armies, in anger, they marched like Indra or Vritasura.459.
The glory of their armies is indescribable, all of them marched after bedcking themselves and the instruments of victory were played.460.

597.g: ਹਣੇ ਸੂਰ ਬੰਕੇ ਗਿਰੇ ਝੂਮਿ ਭੂਮੀ ॥੪੬੧॥
597.t: hane soor ba(n)ke gire jhoom bhoomee ||461||
597.e: Many bloody and great sword-wielders and armour-wearers were conquered, many Kandhari warriors, wearing large steel-armours, were destroyed, many elegant warriors of Rum country were killed and those great warriors swung and fell on the earth.461.

597.g: ਭਜੇ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਭਏ ਬੰਦ ਢੀਲੇ ॥੪੬੨॥
597.t: bhaje traas kai kai bhe ba(n)dh ddeele ||462||
597.e: The warriors of Kabul, Babylonia, Kandhar, Iraq and Balkh were destroyed an d they all, getting fearful, fled away.462.

597.g: ਤਜੇ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਸਜੇ ਨਾਰਿ ਭੇਸੰ ॥
597.t: taje asatr sasatra(n) saje naar bhesa(n) ||

597.g: ਲਜੈ ਬੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ਚਲੇ ਛਾਡਿ ਦੇਸੰ ॥
597.t: lajai beer dheera(n) chale chhaadd dhesa(n) ||

597.g: ਗਜੀ ਬਾਜਿ ਗਾਜੀ ਰਥੀ ਰਾਜ ਹੀਣੰ ॥
597.t: gajee baaj gaajee rathee raaj heena(n) ||

597.g: ਤਜੈ ਬੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ਭਏ ਅੰਗ ਛੀਣੰ ॥੪੬੩॥
597.t: tajai beer dheera(n) bhe a(n)g chheena(n) ||463||
597.e: The warriors, abandoning their arms and weapons, assumed the garb of women and getting ashamed, left their own country, the elephant-riders, the horse-riders and chariot-riders were deprived of their kingdom and the warriors forsaking forbearance, became

597.g: ਖੁਲਿਓ ਖਗ ਖੂਨੀ ਤਹਾ ਏਕ ਗਾਜੀ ॥
597.t: khulio khag khoonee tahaa ek gaajee ||

597.g: ਦੁਹੂੰ ਸੈਣ ਮਧੰ ਨਚਿਓ ਜਾਇ ਤਾਜੀ ॥੪੬੪॥
597.t: dhuhoo(n) sain madha(n) nachio jai taajee ||464||
597.e: The negroes and people of other countries fled away, and in the same way, the barbarians of Armenia also ran away, there one of the warriors taking out his sword, caused his horse to dance between both the armies.464.

597.g: ਲਖਿਓ ਜੁਧ ਜੰਗੀ ਮਹਾ ਜੰਗ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
597.t: lakhio judh ja(n)gee mahaa ja(n)g karataa ||

597.g: ਛੁਭੇ ਛਤ੍ਰਿ ਹੰਤਾ ਜਯੰ ਜੁਧ ਹੇਤਾ ॥੪੬੫॥
597.t: chhubhe chhatr ha(n)taa jaya(n) judh hetaa ||465||
597.e: The Lord, the Great Creator of the wars saw all this and the destroyer of the great canopied-kings, the Lord (Kalki) became enraged, that Lord was the conqueror of the noteworthy most tyrannical armies and he got terrible infuriated.465.

597.g: ਮਹਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੈ ਬਾਣ ਛਡੇ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
597.t: mahaa krodh kai baan chhadde apaara(n) ||

597.g: ਗਿਰੀ ਲੁਥ ਜੁਥੰ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਥ ਬਥੰ ॥
597.t: giree luth jutha(n) mile hath batha(n) ||

597.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗੰ ਰਣੰ ਮੁਖ ਜੁਥੰ ॥੪੬੬॥
597.t: gire a(n)g bha(n)ga(n) rana(n) mukh jutha(n) ||466||
597.e: He discharged arrows in great rage and the army of that king was chopped and knocked down, the corpses fell in groups, heaps of hands, waists and other broken limbs fell down.466.

597.g: ਤਜੈ ਜ੍ਵਾਲ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਜ੍ਵਾਲੀ ॥
597.t: tajai javaiaal maalaa mahaa jot javaiaalee ||

597.g: ਹਸੈ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੰ ਤੁਟੈ ਤਥਿ ਤਾਲੰ ॥
597.t: hasai bhoot preta(n) tuTai tath taala(n) ||

597.g: ਫਿਰੈ ਗਉਰ ਦੌਰੀ ਪੁਐ ਰੁੰਡ ਮਾਲੰ ॥੪੬੭॥
597.t: firai gaur dhauaree puaai ru(n)dd maala(n) ||467||
597.e: The crows shouted caw and the flames of fire arose creating crackling noise, the ghosts and fiends laughed there and the goddess Kali ran, while stringing the rosaries of skulls.467.
The warriors, getting enraged, waged war and discharged arrows, they were shouting “kill, kill”, while showering arrows.468.

598.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗੰ ॥
598.t: gire a(n)g bha(n)ga(n) ||

598.g: ਨਚੇ ਜੰਗ ਰੰਗੰ ॥
598.t: nache ja(n)g ra(n)ga(n) ||

598.g: ਦਿਵੰ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
598.t: dhiva(n) dhev dhekhai ||

598.g: ਧਨੰ ਧਨਿ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੪੬੯॥
598.t: dhana(n) dhan lekhai ||469||
598.e: Dancing in the mood of fighting, the warriors fell with broken limbs, and both the gods and demons, on seeing them said “bravo, bravo”.469.

598.g: ਅਸਤਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
598.t: asataa chha(n)dh ||

598.g: ਅਸਿ ਲੈ ਕਲਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪਿ ਭਰਿਓ ॥
598.t: as lai kalakee kar kop bhario ||

598.g: ਰਣ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਚਰਿਓ ॥
598.t: ran ra(n)g sura(n)g bikhai bichario ||

598.g: ਗਹਿ ਪਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਣ ਬਿਖੇ ਨ ਡਰਿਓ ॥
598.t: geh paan kirapaan bikhe na ddario ||

598.g: ਰਿਸ ਸੋ ਰਣ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿਓ ॥੪੭੦॥
598.t: ris so ran chitr bachitr kario ||470||
598.e: The Lord (Kalki) taking his sword in his hand, became filled with anger and began to roam in the battlefield in fighting mood, holding his bow and sword fearlessly and angrily, he began to move in the battlefield in a queer way.470.

598.g: ਕਰਿ ਹਾਕਿ ਹਥਿਯਾਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਧਰੈ ॥
598.t: kar haak hathiyaar anek dharai ||

598.g: ਰਣ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਠੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਪਰੈ ॥
598.t: ran ra(n)g haThee kar kop parai ||

598.g: ਗਹਿ ਪਾਨਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਭਿਰੇ ॥
598.t: geh paan kirapaan nidhaan bhire ||

598.g: ਰਣਿ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੇ ਨ ਫਿਰੇ ॥੪੭੧॥
598.t: ran joojh mare fir te na fire ||471||
598.e: Holding various weapons and challenging with anger and persistence, he fell upon the opponents in war, holding his sword in his hand, he became engrossed in fighting and did not recede.471.

598.g: ਉਮਡੀ ਜਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਘਮੰਡ ਘਟਾ ॥
598.t: aumaddee jan ghor ghama(n)dd ghaTaa ||

598.g: ਚਮਕੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਣ ਸੁ ਬਿਜੁ ਛਟਾ ॥
598.t: chamaka(n)t kirapaan su bij chhaTaa ||

598.g: ਦਲ ਬੈਰਨ ਕੋ ਪਗ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਨ ਫਟਾ ॥
598.t: dhal bairan ko pag dhavai na faTaa ||

598.g: ਰੁਪ ਕੈ ਰਣ ਮੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਜੁਟਾ ॥੪੭੨॥
598.t: rup kai ran mo fir aan juTaa ||472||
598.e: Like the lightning of the rushing clouds, the swords gleamed, the army of the enemies did not even recede two steps backwards and in its fury, came to fight again in the war-arena.472.

598.g: ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਫਿਰੇ ਰਣ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਠੀ ॥
598.t: kar kop fire ran ra(n)g haThee ||

598.g: ਤਪ ਕੈ ਜਿਮਿ ਪਾਵਕ ਜ੍ਵਾਲ ਭਠੀ ॥
598.t: tap kai jim paavak javaiaal bhaThee ||

598.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਨਾ ਇਕਠੀ ॥
598.t: pratinaa pat kai pratinaa ikaThee ||

598.g: ਰਿਸ ਕੈ ਰਣ ਮੋ ਰੁਪਿ ਸੈਣ ਜੁਟੀ ॥੪੭੩॥
598.t: ris kai ran mo rup sain juTee ||473||
598.e: The persistent warriors were getting angry in the war like the furnace with blazing flames, the army revolved and gathered together and was engrossed in fighting with great rage.473.

598.g: ਤਰਵਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਹਜਾਰ ਲਸੈ ॥
598.t: taravaar apaar hajaar lasai ||

598.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਅਰਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਅੰਗ ਡਸੈ ॥
598.t: har jiau ar kai pratia(n)g ddasai ||

598.g: ਰਤ ਡੂਬਿ ਸਮੈ ਰਣਿ ਐਸ ਹਸੈ ॥
598.t: rat ddoob samai ran aais hasai ||

599.e: Thousands of swords were looking magnificent and it appeared that the snakes were stinging every limb, the swords seemed smiling like the flash of the dreadful lightning.474.
The swords are glistening like the fires or like the smiling damsels or like the flashing lightning.475.
While inflicting wounds, they are moving like the restless modifications of mind, the broken limbs are falling like meteors.476.

The goddess Kalika is laughing in the battlefield and the frightening ghosts are shouting, just as the lightning is flashing, In the same manner, the heavenly damsels are looking at the battlefield and dancing.477.
Bhairavi is shouting and the yoginis are laughing, the sharp swords fulfilling the desires, are striking the blows.478.

The goddess Kali is seriously enumerating the corpses and filling her bowl with blood, is looking magnificent, she is moving carelessly and seems like a portrait, she is repeating the Lord’s Name.479.
She is stringing the rosary of skulls and putting it around her neck, she is laughing, the ghosts are also visible there and the battlefield has become an unapproachable place.480.

599.g: ਜਬੈ ਜੰਗ ਜੰਗੀ ਰਚਿਓ ਜੰਗ ਜੋਰੰ ॥
599.t: jabai ja(n)g ja(n)gee rachio ja(n)g jora(n) ||

599.g: ਹਨੇ ਬੀਰ ਬੰਕੇ ਤਮੰ ਜਾਣੁ ਭੋਰੰ ॥
599.t: hane beer ba(n)ke tama(n) jaan bhora(n) ||

599.g: ਸਜੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਧਸਿਓ ਲੋਹ ਧਾਰੰ ॥੪੮੧॥
599.t: saje sarab sasatra(n) dhasio loh dhaara(n) ||481||
599.e: When the warriors waged a powerful war, many elegant fighters were killed, then Kalki thundered and bedecked with all the weapons, penetrated into the current of steel-weapons.481.

599.g: ਜਯਾ ਸਬਦ ਉਠੇ ਰਹੇ ਲੋਗ ਪੂਰੰ ॥
599.t: jayaa sabadh uThe rahe log poora(n) ||

599.g: ਖੁਰੰ ਖੇਹ ਉਠੀ ਛੁਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਸੂਰੰ ॥
599.t: khura(n) kheh uThee chhuhee jai soora(n) ||

599.e: There was such a thundering sound that the people were absorbed in the illusion and the dust of the horses’ feet arose high to touch the sky, because of the dust, the golden rays disappeared and the darkness prevailed, in that confusion, there was a showe

599.g: ਹਣਿਓ ਜੋਰ ਜੰਗੰ ਤਜਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਸੈਣੰ ॥
599.t: hanio jor ja(n)ga(n) tajio sarab saina(n) ||

599.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਣੰ ਦੰਤ ਥਾਭੈ ਬਕੈ ਦੀਨ ਬੈਣੰ ॥
599.t: tirana(n) dha(n)t thaabhai bakai dheen baina(n) ||

599.g: ਭਜੇ ਗਰਬ ਸਰਬੰ ਤਜੇ ਰਾਜ ਸਾਜੰ ॥੪੮੩॥
599.t: bhaje garab saraba(n) taje raaj saaja(n) ||483||
599.e: In that dreadful war, the army, being destroyed, ran away and pressing straw between the teeth, it began to shout with humility, seeing this the king also abandoned his pride and ran away leaving behind his kingdom and all his paraphernalia.483.

Many Kashmiri and patient, persistent and enduring warriors were chopped and killed and many canopied, many mighty Gurdezi fighters and fighters of other countries, who were siding that king with great foolishness, were defeated.484.

599.g: ਹਣੇ ਰੂਸਿ ਤੂਸੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਜੋਧੀ ॥
599.t: hane roos toosee kiratee chitr jodhee ||

599.e: The Russians,Turkistanis, Sayyads and other persistent and angry fighters were killed, the dreadful fighting soldiers of Kandhar and many other canopied and angry warriors were also made lifeless.485.

599.g: ਛੁਟੇ ਬਾਣ ਗੋਲੰ ਉਠੇ ਅਗ ਨਾਲੰ ॥
599.t: chhuTe baan gola(n) uThe ag naala(n) ||

600.g: ਘੁਰੇ ਜਾਣ ਸ੍ਯਾਮੰ ਘਟਾ ਜਿਮਿ ਜ੍ਵਾਲੰ ॥
600.t: ghure jaan sayaama(n) ghaTaa jim javaiaala(n) ||

600.g: ਨਚੇ ਈਸ ਸੀਸੰ ਪੁਐ ਰੁੰਡ ਮਾਲੰ ॥
600.t: nache iees seesa(n) puaai ru(n)dd maala(n) ||

600.g: ਜੁਝੇ ਬੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ਬਰੈ ਬੀਨਿ ਬਾਲੰ ॥੪੮੬॥
600.t: jujhe beer dheera(n) barai been baala(n) ||486||
600.e: With the discharge of arrows, the firearms wre discharged like the fires rising in clourds, Shiva, dancing with his pleasure, strung the rosaries of skulls, the warriors began to fight and wed the heavenly damsels after selecting them.486.

600.g: ਗਿਰੈ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗੰ ਭ੍ਰਮੰ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੰ ॥
600.t: girai a(n)g bha(n)ga(n) bhrama(n) ru(n)dd mu(n)dda(n) ||

600.g: ਗਜੀ ਬਾਜ ਗਾਜੀ ਗਿਰੈ ਬੀਰ ਝੁੰਡੰ ॥
600.t: gajee baaj gaajee girai beer jhu(n)dda(n) ||

600.g: ਉਠੇ ਤਛ ਮੁਛੰ ਭਈ ਲੋਹ ਪੂਰੰ ॥੪੮੭॥
600.t: auThe tachh muchha(n) bhiee loh poora(n) ||487||
600.e: Getting truncated and having the limbs broken the riders of elephants, the horses and other warriors began to fall in groups, the hearts of the warriors throbbed with each challenge and with the rising of the fighters with beautiful whiskers the earth bec
He, who resisted before them, was killed and he, who was defeated, he surrendered, in this way, all were delightfully adjusted.488.
So much charity was bestowed, that they can only be described by the poets, all the kings became happy and the horns of victory sounded.489.
The Khorasan country was conquered and taking every-one with him, the Lord (Kalki) gave his mantra and Yantra to everyone.490.
From there, sounding trumpets and taking all the army alongwith him he marched forward, the warriors had the swords and quivers, they were extremely angry and clashing warriors.491.
The earth trembled and the Sheshnaga repeated Lord’s Names, the dreadful bells of war rang, the warriors in ire discharged arrows and shouted “kill, kill” from their mouth.492.

600.g: ਗਣ ਗਿਧ ਸੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਰੜੰਤ ਨਭੰ ॥
600.t: gan gidh su biradh raRa(n)t nabha(n) ||

600.e: Enduring the anguish of wounds, they began to inflict wounds and cut the good steel-armours in the battlefield, the ghosts and the vultures moved in the sky and the vampires shrieked vultures moved in the sky and the vampires shrieked violently.493.

600.g: ਗਣਿ ਹੂਰ ਸੁ ਪੂਰ ਫਿਰੀ ਗਗਨੰ ॥
600.t: gan hoor su poor firee gagana(n) ||

600.g: ਗਣ ਪੂਰ ਸੁ ਪਖਰ ਹੂਰ ਫਿਰੀ ॥੪੯੪॥
600.t: gan poor su pakhar hoor firee ||494||
600.e: The heavenly damsels moved in the sky and they came to look for and take refuge with the warriors in the battlefield, they sang song from their mouths and in this way, the ganas and heavenly damsels roamed in the sky.496.

600.g: ਪ੍ਰਣ ਪੂਰ ਸੁ ਪਛਿਮ ਜੀਤ ਰਣੰ ॥੪੯੫॥
600.t: pran poor su pachhim jeet rana(n) ||495||
600.e: Seeing the warriors, Shiva began to string the rosary of skulls and Yoginis laughed and moved, the fighters, roaming in the armies received wounds and in this way they began to fulfill their promise of conquering the West.495.

600.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਪਛਿਮ ਦਿਸਾ ਦਛਨ ਕੀਨ ਪਿਆਨ ॥
600.t: jeet sarab pachhim dhisaa dhachhan keen piaan ||

600.g: ਜਿਮਿ ਜਿਮਿ ਜੁਧ ਤਹਾ ਪਰਾ ਤਿਮਿ ਤਿਮਿ ਕਰੋ ਬਖਾਨ ॥੪੯੬॥
600.t: jim jim judh tahaa paraa tim tim karo bakhaan ||496||
600.e: Conquering the whole of the west, Kalki thought of moving towards the South and I do not relate the wars, that occurred there.496.
